Join me for a meet and greet with the future Congresswoman Leslie Lewallen | | https://us5.forward-to-friend.com/forward?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id;=252e8c5998&e;=77eef70c61 | Is this email not displaying correctly?
[View it in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/b6871007e180/i-now-have-two-inexperienced-but-equally-matched-hyper-partisan-opponents-who-want-to-turn-the-county-council-into-the-failed-seattle-city-council-939?e=77eef70c61).
---|---
|
---
| | Reagan Dunn, J.D.
Vice Chairman King County Council
Friends,

My longtime friend, Leslie Marshall Lewallen, is running for Congress down in Southwest Washington. She is an exceptional candidate, and I'm helping her raise some money for her campaign. I'm writing today with two favors:

1. Can you attend her upcoming campaign reception in Bellevue? The details of the reception are in the invitation below (Wednesday, September 27th , 5:00 - 7:00pm in downtown Bellevue). I promise you'll not only enjoy meeting Leslie, but after you do, you'll be excited to support her campaign. If you are interested in attending contact anitra.zipperer@gmail.com or call/text (253) 241-2420
2. If you can't attend, [would you support her race with a donation? ](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=20a943a101&e=77eef70c61)She's raising money ahead of her September 30th fundraising deadline. She really needs our help - [Can you pitch in and join me in supporting her?](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=baad82a9f9&e=77eef70c61)

**Here are a couple things I want you to know about Leslie:**
* She's a current Camas City Council member, a mother a four, and a former King County Prosecutor. She grew up in the Pacific Northwest and has always been a strong advocate for her community. She ran and won a seat on the Camas City Council, having no prior political experience. But what she has is a "can do" attitude, a strong work ethic, and a commitment to problem solving.
* Leslie is acutely aware of the issues that really matter in our region - the rising costs of inflation, deadly fentanyl coming through our Southern border and entering our communities, and the homeless crisis that's made our streets less safe. I have no doubt that once elected, she'll hit the ground running.

**Here are a couple things I want you to know about the District:**
* Our 3rd Congressional District was, until 2022, represented by my friend, and fellow Republican Jaime Herrera Beutler for more than a decade.
* It's a red district, where in 2022, Republican candidate Tiffany Smiley won by 7% and Republican President Donald Trump won by 4%. Yet, the 2022 Republican candidate lost this seat to an unknown Democrat newcomer.
* To win back the district we need to put forth a candidate like Leslie who is a good fit for the region.

The numbers are on Leslie's side to win this thing. She honestly just needs the resources to do so. So, please, come meet her on September 27th in Bellevue,**[or make a donation to her campaign.](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=12438f179e&e=77eef70c61)**

Thank you so much!!

Sincerely,

****
Councilmember Reagan Dunn

Yesterday, 70,000 people marched in in New York City to end fossil fuels.
Organizers were expecting 10,000 people to show up. The final number was nearly 7X.
Our movement to end fossil fuels must become too radical and too big to ignore.
[Please, will you rush a $5 contribution right now? Every single contribution helps leverage this grassroots movement into real policy actions.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230918.xkxPSP&refcode=em20230918-5005-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5005%2E2526796%2EusSK-2)

Team AOC

During a trip, certain add-ons can turn a good experience into a remarkable, once-in-a-lifetime event. MIGOP offers various VIP benefits for those interested.
MIGOP is hosting a special event on Friday evening, which includes a meet and greet featuring **JIM CAVIEZEL** as a special guest. The event will take place in the Pontiac Room at the Grand Hotel, which has a beautiful private front porch.
Only a limited number of guests, up to 30 VIPs, will be able to attend this exclusive event. After the meet and greet, there will be a VIP dinner with Chairwoman Kristina Karamo.
Mackinac Island is surrounded by a picturesque lake and bridge, offering stunning photo opportunities at sunrise and sunset. This year, we have arranged two exclusive yacht cruises.
On Friday, there will be a **Remembering Reagan Sunset Cruise** with former Ronald Reagan Ambassador Dr. Alan Keyes. The cruise will depart to the bridge and back, lasting approximately 60 minutes. Hor d'oeuvres and wine will be available for guests.
**On Friday night, there will be a Moonlight Yacht Cruise with Chairwoman Kristina Karamo**. The cruise will depart at 10.15 PM and return to the bridge and back, lasting approximately 60 minutes. Hor d'oeuvres and wine will be available for guests.
MIGOP has partnered with the GRAND HOTEL to offer a meal package to off-site guests. The package includes dinner on Friday, breakfast and dinner on Saturday, and breakfast on Sunday.
Breakfast is available from **7:30 AM to 10:00 AM** and offers a variety of options including fruits, oats, grains, pastries, and eggs. Notable entrée dishes include avocado terrain and smoked salmon.
The Grand Hotel serves dinner from **6:30 PM to 8:45 PM** and is renowned for its three rotating seasonal menus that offer a diverse selection of soups, salads, and appetizers such as smoked salted cured salmon, nudja bolognese & calamari, and wild mushroom risotto.
For those seeking something more unique, options include frog legs provencale, foie gras and chicken liver pate, and wagyu beef tartare.
For the main course, options include a bone-in pork chop, roasted duck breast, veal schnitzel, herb-roasted half chicken, leg of lamb, and prime rib of beef.
**If you are a guest at the Grand Hotel, breakfast and dinner are included in your package.**

| Peter, It’s a scene that’s become far too common here in California and one that played out again just a few weeks ago...

A pack of thieves storm into a department store, breaking windows and making off with trash bags full of thousands of dollars in merchandise in just the latest instance of what is commonly known as a _“smash-and-grab”_ robbery.
---

---
| It’s despicable, Peter**.**

But sadly, it’s become commonplace here in California thanks to soft-on-crime politicians who let these criminals off the hook and seriously even call to **defund our police!**

_No wonder so many Californians are now questioning the basic safety of their state..._

**Look – my name’s Scott Baugh, and as Chairman of a Gang Reduction Intervention program here in the Golden State, stopping this California Crime Wave has been a personal mission for me.**

But at the end of the day, I know that we won’t see a change on the ground until we also see a change in leadership.

That’s why I’m running for Congress in 2024 to flip a House seat currently held by soft-on-crime Democrat Katie Porter.

She’s running for Senate next year, making this district even more winnable – and if conservatives prevail, it will be a major blow to the far-left agenda that’s turned California _into a haven for criminals._

**Is that a mission you can get behind, Peter? If so,[ please chip in what you can to help me stop this madness and keep our streets safe!](https://baughforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c960c16667ac69bd188629a19&id=6ad04234ab&e=8a657725d1)**

body:
The top two vote getters—regardless of party—move on to the general election in November.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=30086%2E3422442%2EKsOge1)
Derek, last month, we shared ten fun facts about Katie Porter (like that she was in 4-H as a kid and her go to drink is Diet Dr. Pepper). **This month, we’re sharing a few facts about what makes California’s Senate race unique:**
1. **The primary is on March 5, 2024.**
2. **The top two vote getters—**regardless of party** —move on to the general election in November.**
3. **Candidates are funding their campaigns in a variety of ways: Katie is the only candidate in this race rejecting contributions from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, and Big Oil, Big Pharma and Big Bank CEOs.**
4. **Because of California’s size and pricey media markets, this could be the year’s most expensive Senate primary.
**
5. **The person Californians elect isn’t just another vote in the Senate—they’ll have the chance to guide our party’s priorities and messaging for decades to come.**

Derek, this competitive primary is less than six months away and polling has Katie three points behind our opponent. body:
Dr. Cornel West at Climate Week in NYC

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=L0vWSOy_QdrTdUsf_jo6vHg9O7xvFPHoRyHNejdpv68&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20230918climatechange&n=1)
---
Peter - Dr. Cornel West is participating in this year’s Climate Week in New York City, calling for global cooperation to expedite the immediate cessation of new oil, gas, and coal extraction. Dr. West said, “We’re literally paying out climate criminals for years of destruction and environmental racism. It’s time to flip the script. Instead of paying the fossil fuel pipers, we need to make the pipers pay.” **This is a crucial moment in our fight against climate change,[and we need your support to make a difference.](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20230918climatechange&n=2)**
---

---
This campaign is challenging the recklessness of the corporate duopoly, which gives us false choices, false solutions, and false hopes. As Dr. West has said, “There’s no more time for the empty proclamations and broken promises of this administration; the people won’t stand for it anymore.” **President Biden has issued more oil and gas leases at this point in his presidency than the entirety of Trump’s, continuing the neoliberal approach to climate change of the Obama administration.** We need new and principled leadership that will declare a climate emergency and take immediate action to save the planet for future generations.
---

body:
We've sent a few fundraising emails since Republican Mike Rogers announced he was getting into Michigan's Senate race.

| Peter -

We've sent a few fundraising emails since Republican Mike Rogers announced he was getting into Michigan's Senate race.

And while I know as well as anyone that an inbox filled with fundraising solicitations can be a serious drag, we hope you'll take the number of messages we've sent as a sign of just how important this moment is for our campaign. We’ve gone six months with crickets, now things are starting to ramp up.

You see, Mike Rogers, or whoever the Republicans nominate in this race, is going to raise almost all of their money through corporate PACs or super PACs spending millions on TV for them.

| | America is facing several generational defining challenges, my friend. And as a true, red-blooded Republican, I believe our party holds the common sense solutions to solve them. _**That's why I'm calling for a reboot of the Republican Party.**_ I'm leading a movement to take back our base and make it a big tent Party once more. **[Will you chip in $5, $20.24, $50, or another amount today to help us bring this movement to the attention of the politically disenfranchised?](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=34d89e461aaa44c78b8907f4a4a14a11&_m=d8232ff8d6334e63844af743386cc882&_e=wWhHxNWBLPghJDZUTFZU5TBliskILcls8xaH79kG4NNCyCvsZlunQ9piSgOSkaFut3JKZ8Tumnsrh33wMYN6RkbJdsJRFIKJtmfY5ULZm3pv-Ka02aVEzs3kItkTRBdSLO80yokorkuvYDJMdgRIWfDi_fewChAWdf03bUZPlAwoZ3zDQQAldSQpI5DYUotuU-2PsmmOH7ZjRTlt40jyiKIU1FOvzc6rioDDHCMijMX7IGLG7WSHTVz2DIqxRqo8jouoqy3_oWezi0gWUV8FTNfeQC_BxrcU_BnLp3RdgGiciLmB2TZdmdlNEMT2jDMbwHc3T-Ux8nE1X83pIQA51USWgXQuBta2APmYTqhTM92FGQvzbU6qF-5JSbLh5AvMTXE_FdUF5T1RRalmzsdvIw%3D%3D)**

Our movement is working to appeal to the middle, not the edges. _**It's not easy.**_ So many smart and sensible people have seen the state of our political arena, thrown their hands in the air, and given up. I want to re-engage with those folks. America needs to be represented by its people as a whole, not just the fringes. I think the Republican Party is capable of doing that by:
* _**Aligning our actions with our values**_
* _**Showing up to listen**_
* _**Stop being a jerk, racist, misogynist or homophobe**_
* _**Appealing to the middle**_
* _**Building trust**_

Obviously, there's more we can do. But these 5 things are a strong start to rebooting the party of Lincoln and Reagan. clean_body: | | | | | America is facing several generational defining challenges, my friend. And as a true, red-blooded Republican, I believe our party holds the common sense solutions to solve them. That's why I'm calling for a reboot of the Republican Party. I'm leading a movement to take back our base and make it a big tent Party once more. Our movement is working to appeal to the middle, not the edges. It's not easy. So many smart and sensible people have seen the state of our political arena, thrown their hands in the air, and given up. I want to re-engage with those folks. America needs to be represented by its people as a whole, not just the fringes. I think the Republican Party is capable of doing that by: Aligning our actions with our values Showing up to listen Stop being a jerk, racist, misogynist or homophobe Appealing to the middle Building trust Obviously, there's more we can do. But these 5 things are a strong start to rebooting the party of Lincoln and Reagan. There's way more that unites us than divides us. Thank you,Will Hurd** Candidate for President & Former TX Congressman | | | | | | |

subject: Call to Action Sept. 12: Don’t let up – spending & impeachment
body:
| | | [](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjMyNjItMjQ0OTAxNTEzMjkyNDA4YjkzZjkzMmRiYmExMjdmMmIiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMCIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vbGlua3RyLmVlL2plbm55YmV0aG0_bWlkPTQ2NTI1JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/A4uM1u42f5tm2baqj-RgPA)
---
| | |
---
---
On September 30th, the authorization to fund the government's functions and programs will expire. If Congress does not approve a new budget or pass a Continuing Resolution, there would be a temporary shutdown. This is something the liberal media and the Democrats use to bully Republicans into caving every year, despite essential programs still running and all government employees later receiving pay for any time missed. It’s time for House Republicans to preserve the American Dream and prove to the people that they’re worthy of the majority. The Senate is another story – there are so many squishy Republicans who are willing to work with Democrats on everything that it is a different situation (and so we have different sample call scripts for each chamber). Before we can fund the government, we need to ensure that our freedoms as Americans are protected. We need to establish fiscal security and stop reckless spending. **We need to secure the border, starting with**[**HR2**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjMyNjItMjQ0OTAxNTEzMjkyNDA4YjkzZjkzMmRiYmExMjdmMmIiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMSIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmNiby5nb3YvcHVibGljYXRpb24vNTkxNTE_bWlkPTQ2NTI1JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/hc8IxWvVkYarH5-NNgNyPw)**, the Secure the Border Act.** We need to stop the Department of Justice from politicizing issues, and instead focus on the safety of Americans. We need to end the war on reliable energy and bring prices back down. For more information, see this [**Twitter thread**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-QJ0ZXwjbtdbtW_KgjKQ)**.** The Secure the Border Act is something that could even happen if the GOP leadership caves and agrees to a Continuing Resolution. The House has already passed HR 2, so it should be no problem at all to include it in regular appropriations bills or in a Continuing Resolution. **With 5,000 – 7,000 (or more) illegal aliens pouring across the border EVERY DAY, the Secure the Border Act must absolutely be a part of any funding legislation that is passed. Period.** **I’m asking all grassroots patriots to call your representative and both of your senators and use the sample scripts below to help you with your message.** **WE MUST MELT THE HOUSE PHONE LINES NOW!** **Call your representative by calling the U.S. House switchboard****at (202) 224-3121 and ask for your representative by name.** **If you don’t know his or her name, you can also look up names****and phone numbers on the** [**House website**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.--WevR-8Q9GowfJgs5hnA)**.**
---
| | **Sample Call Script for House Member** _“As your constituent I am asking you to stand firm against any Continuing Resolution, and to stop funding an anti-American agenda. If there is No Security, there should be No Funding. Americans want fiscal security - which means cutting spending and stopping inflation. We want border security - which means including HR2 in any spending bill – whether regular appropriations bills or a Continuing Resolution. We want our constitutional rights secured - which means American departments and agencies like the DOJ and FBI to stop targeting and persecuting citizens who disagree with this administration. We want national security - which means a DOD that is more concerned with protecting us from our enemies like China instead of hosting drag shows and forcing our servicemen and women to post their pronouns. We want energy security - which means stop the war on American energy. No Continuing Resolution. No security, no funding. Thank you.”_ **Sample Call Script for Senators** _“I am a constituent and I am calling about funding the government. I want my senator to vote against any Continuing Resolution that does not include HR 2, the Secure the Border Act; that does not defund the DOJ’s persecutions of Americans who oppose the Biden administration; and does not defund radical, woke elements in our military. There is no reason we should be funding things in the military that aren’t critical to carrying out its mission to protect our nation from foreign enemies. And, with an average of at least 5,000 – 7,000 illegal aliens crossing our border every single day, and as the House has already passed HR 2, the Senate absolutely must include HR 2 in any funding bill so that our borders are secured. There is never a good time for the American government to target, harass, and persecute citizens for exercising our God-given, constitutionally-guaranteed rights, and opposing the current administration. It is shameful that this is happening and it must stop. Our national debt is almost $33 TRILLION dollars. It’s time for the Senate to actually care about American citizens and secure our nation!”_
---
| | In liberty, Jenny Beth Martin PS – We will be limited in emails we can send this week, so [**please watch our X account**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) for updates, as well as text messages if the updates require urgent action.

There is never a good time for the American government to target, harass, and persecute citizens for exercising our God-given, constitutionally-guaranteed rights, and opposing the current administration. ## Military Finds Debris of Missing F-35 Jet
The U.S. military has found debris from the [wreckage of an F-35 jet](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O6yAUBp8Gd1hw-LEpKG5Dl9tuaRE4xETYRIbEytuvknrr79NoND-X5eJzyfvtv9_Q9lQXH3p-4cIM5YaCWGCINiECigEt10ZxUJPhw2pn1LPRIqSA2kQvQadJqUmwmBSi1kO2wEAwww0zSko2ein4LCAwmUQKUyCSYcy9HuO95r2vmMq7vvAYQ92GYtfeH42IfwQcAXee51jyC9WOZ_s8CLgPn4BjhoDjMwEX8XrkRlPGEmmqzz3Shv4IK01UKHrHTs9cSvZbuz6PGw31ufc3ATccNj6-U9MTkey2-Vy-Hv3vLL8BAAD__yN9Yrk) about two hours northeast of its air base in North Charleston, S.C. It isn't known if anyone on the ground was injured in the crash. The $80 million jet went missing Sunday afternoon after the pilot ejected, and the plane kept flying on autopilot. The aircraft could fly unpiloted for some time, and U.S. Marine officials asked the public for help locating the stealth jet. Authorities are being tight-lipped about what caused the pilot to eject or the exact location of the crash, and they've ordered [a stand-down of all aviation units](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1u7CAQxfGnwR0WDPiDguI27va2Ka1ZGNZEGFtA1tq3jzZKme4nnebo_3FbbxhTzI__uJNt4VjRtfikVRguDQe1QudtIAJSHVk5mkHCMBnZbXaQNEq6I-rJeaPnyTgKsxMBzCymEbpoQYASRhphBq1Fj1rJWYETOqjgJse0IB_bUfrPI-a2UUiv40mld8feJbu1dlam_jFYGCzXdfX57jJd9b0zWN5ksHxV_qsdS8zEE6Gnwo_iqVReMVB78dowe46xuIKh8cDVwH2seJ6EBbMjXlxGKYZRQFesP6-YUqzjxLR47BjTz6n2d6PvAAAA__-MFGll) for at least two days. This is the military's third major airborne accident in the last two months: an F-18 recently crashed in San Diego, and a helicopter went down in Australia, killing three Marines and twenty other military personnel.
## Senate Drops Dress Code, Hoodies Now OK
The Senate will [drop its dress code](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAURb8GNiz8wGAGhi7e0rWjRfAjUGGIgCbq31dp1873Hh3pfFz2i0s5ldu7O9GOUHfnR3rgzg2bDQOxAz1sQAQUFO2szDLDos1MowWtnQtO4aKvV79KpZVwi9FB4yJXxWmywEFwMxtuFin55KSYVwGeyyCC155IjkcatU2fNZURMeTv-sA2-XrSbOMY907EG4GNwDYixpTzayOwxXpiwWcnsHUsbiCBTQI3Qq2s-_h1YmO51o6ls79DZ6mE2k6X2dGwd-br8aJos8f9mXJOXWki-e106ddCx_9BfgIAAP__Z-ViJQ), unwritten but enforced throughout its history, to allow senators to wear whatever they want on the floor, including shorts, gym clothes, as well as the hoodies favored by Sen. John Fetterman. Until now, Fetterman and other senators [not wearing a suit and tie](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71uwyAYAJ8Gb1jw8RcGhi5s6drRQvARU-EQAY3bt6_SufNJd7qP63YNpZb77T0c6GZuW4izPHFjlnJLQWywJJcRAcWCjmurOChj-bI7o7TFFDKXSlmBWuuMCVhWXAR7MbgUBwwEs9wyq6Rka5CCXwREJrPI0UQiGaYyW18_W7nPHXP9aU_sa2zHUt0-52MQ8UbAE_Dnea7hu7TxogT8y03AM0vAc0PAD7yHiTT19hg0dRyDxpaQjrh_HdiX7tLjLLWWoQ2R7HaEUv9K8__x3wAAAP__5btYNw) could only stand on the edge of the Senate chamber to vote. Staff members and visitors to the Senate are still required to wear more formal clothing. Conservatives are calling it [the "Fetterman rule"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1zhCAUAH-Nds_hSz0KijR2lzalg_A4ySA48ObM_fvMpU69ze5-3de7jSnmx6c90FAoq3UUn7gyDVyDkKvovQmIAmWPhk965GKcNe93s4VR3pSVXgftcNomjuhnMWPYBKpJ9dEIJiTTXDM9KsUGqyS_SeGYCjK42XWKoY9U6vBdYqYdQ3qVJ9bBlaNPZic6Wyc_OrF0YrmuawjlJ-PV3rwTy1lSpOhaJ5aARFgPm2FLthF62F7gSm5Yn_Yd1MAGwgoNsyUEX8vZwFdsDVzxCI3KCalcWGN-AO0Im619Nf68YkqxTXOn2OOwMf3J0f-vfgMAAP__eSNvnA) and criticizing it for lowering the standards and respectability of the Senate.
## Mass Production of Humanoid Robots Set to Begin
Agility Robots, maker of Digit, a [high-tech line of humanoid robots,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhDAQRL_GdEZmzcFtQZGG7tKmRMZew0YGI-Ocxd9Hd2nTjmZGT-_rMT0MB96XT7PRkH2cjM38pEmhbFCCnqBygycC0hUNTYe3Bm49NtU66E71HmbsEakzmpz1FpzFDtHcZ20qHkCBVtigwlvbqtq0urlrsKr12tveilaR4xxT_R15zyv5cMUnpdrGrQrDmvNxCv0hYBQwllLqvNJ5XGWNM4dAbqNXU8C4UzkFjGbhwPmSKc4xsz1lPGjnfXkH3syyxBTcKT2nM0tvbI7pkj4muf5sZo_s_qavr0Yrha2AsUqDOwqHwGfXi1Ytm-HwJsz_C_sNAAD__0iEb7k) is about to open RoboFab, the world's first factory to mass produce commercial humanoid robots. RoboFab will employ 500 (human) workers in Salem, Ore., aiming to produce 10,000 robots a year. The first delivery of new Digit robots is expected in 2024. Digit robots have two arms, two legs, and a head that resembles a face ([See Video](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQRn8N3ojgIHYZGLp4S9eO1gUf5ipsIvuaKP--SuZun_RJT0_v-zJdkCtvyxeuFCW3CZPwnSYTtA0a3ATdHDMRkOso2j6cLZyHYLsSB5sxhND31jpjCYeQCK8BwAB58LnjCAacCTaYcPbenNA7--EgGZ9dTkNS3tDM0vbTT-NNCuX6bHfaT6mtXY1F5HYo96lgVDAKpZL23y2V161gfMEVjMa9t4JxJRIthfRGD50xkcZt1gW3-dAta1y4sjz13q5NOB165oVFwdjtcb49uFY--kF5s6zI9e0g_yf5CwAA__8NP2C4)). The robots are designed for bulk material handling in warehouses, helping human workers.

body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1994172?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | Friend, if you had _**$673 BILLION**_ to support causes you care about, what would you do with that money? Conserve our precious public lands? Ensure everyone has safe water to drink? Picture the **ecosystems teeming with wildlife** that you’ve saved. Imagine the **smiling faces of people** who no longer need to worry whether their water is POISONING them. Worth the money, right? Here’s why I ask: banks poured $673 billion into fossil fuel companies _just last year._ Instead of changing lives, Wall Street is funneling cash to the companies **DESTROYING our planet** and **DOOMING the future** for generations to come. But I have good news, Friend -- the Fossil Free Finance Act is a bill in Congress to **STOP banks from financing new fossil fuel projects. This bill won’t pass without environmentalists like you speaking up, and the clock is ticking! [Stop Wall Street from pouring money into greedy fossil fuel corporations. Send your message to Congress now! >>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1994173?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** | [Sign the petition](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1994174?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Let me share an example of the kind of destruction that Wall Street is funding, Friend:
Alaska’s Western Arctic holds stunning natural beauty: majestic caribou shoeing through snowy mountain peaks, glaciers drifting on sparkling blue waters, threatened polar bears lumbering over the icy expanse. It’s truly a sight to behold.
But soon, **pipelines, roads, and airstrips will DESTROY this beautiful scenery.** The Indigenous people who live here and the wildlife they rely on are threatened by the **largest proposed oil project on U.S. land -- the Willow Project.** The company responsible has been financed by Wall Street to the tune of $1.6 billion.
**We need YOUR help to stop big banks from financing more fossil fuel developments like the Willow Project.** But every moment that passes, more money is being funneled into the pockets of greedy companies. [**Please, Friend, take just 30 seconds to help us reach our critical goal of 7,289 messages to Congress by MIDNIGHT tonight! Protect people and our planet from fossil fuel greed!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1994175?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[Sign the petition](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1994176?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

**Standing with you,
Paloma Henriques
Senior petrochemical campaigner,
Friends of the Earth**

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. And I’m officially running to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator. Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m prepared to win. But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The only way I can compete — and win — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you. [I've set an ambitious goal to raise $50,000 by midnight to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach it. Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0e05f14b-f7dd-4dc0-bb5f-e775d6009830/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America. We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet. Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage. My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my family a shot at a better life. Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a billion dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide abortion ban. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare that so many rely on. That’s why I’m running to defeat him next November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, Peter, we can take him down. [So please, I’m personally asking: Will you become one of my very first grassroots donors by splitting a gift between my campaign and Blue Amp Action today? Every dollar gets us one step closer to defeating Rick Scott and defending our Senate majority.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf645b62e-8706-459b-978d-64b54deb4a0e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Peter,

My name is Kevin Lincoln. I’m a proud United States Marine Corps veteran, and I’m a conservative Republican running for Congress in California’s competitive 9th district.

I joined the Marine Corps in 2001 and became a military police officer. In the aftermath of the September 11th attacks, I was assigned to the White House Military Office attached to the Marine One aircraft – _an assignment of great honor and great responsibility._

**Our mission was to protect and securely transport the President of the United States following the attack on our country.**

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=bc486aaf673144d884a7622c653260d1&_e=KC01sAlgfZv-YpIAy55UoSU3OFRLwrhDIxfPO9jVQDQk6hqO1RguyP762b_QJpv06a3kWB9nbAg7DI96XbIjMEkuXi7wPqEk6x4Xt0JZRfas4YzIfVIozt8r5_98r3sef8CVgCVI20qwcsok8al0OqtuXDU-liNTdx_wED-U1ACqGUMSXF12G-K2npoOvD_yynF_hAwj0Z4zgu9BOEvd61MmVeiQqjCfv6l8ppVEWfa8K-oJS0sfIVrL26VW3_KPeuImgmYYY5LX4Eqy3MLomNNpQ0t22D5SjIhkgdZjIdG446zaUNix9or3zy1z8PD3rA7zmfhJAVmWRVqkh-JPJKYlZ0WY9CJYNQraH2Cs2MQuCCNOysnjg-pb0qfY7v2_)
**Now, I’m stepping up to serve my country again – this time in the House of Representatives.**

[ ** Send a Marine to Congress ➞ **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=bc486aaf673144d884a7622c653260d1&_e=KC01sAlgfZv-YpIAy55UoSU3OFRLwrhDIxfPO9jVQDQk6hqO1RguyP762b_QJpv06a3kWB9nbAg7DI96XbIjMEkuXi7wPqEk6x4Xt0JZRfas4YzIfVIozt8r5_98r3sef8CVgCVI20qwcsok8al0OqtuXDU-liNTdx_wED-U1ACqGUMSXF12G-K2npoOvD_yynF_hAwj0Z4zgu9BOEvd61MmVeiQqjCfv6l8ppVEWfbG2KWjoW0J4h_kvqHJJj5hbyY2ap2CFhWzV2kaHwsNn0rhPEyS0pWyMn3r4RqE2GX41lbHAiQqh4GPzFF57OteXVn3ac9LqEtkzkXcCKd6QVESlL2mTaDcSqN8YVz-l8yS-Fzt5P-Qr_ap5czn1CfT)
My incumbent Democrat opponent, Josh Harder, is not serving our country. He has failed not just our district, but also those who wear the uniform.

Harder voted AGAINST protecting critical benefits for our veterans and AGAINST raising the pay of our active-duty service men and women. _This is unacceptable!_

**Together, Harder and Biden have failed our veterans and our military.**

**Those who serve our country, along with their families, deserve so much better. In Congress, I will make protecting veterans’ benefits and raising military pay among my top priorities.**

[**If you support our veterans and active-duty military, will you ensure they have a voice in Congress by supporting my campaign with a contribution of $10, $25, $50 or more today?**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=bc486aaf673144d884a7622c653260d1&_e=KC01sAlgfZv-YpIAy55UoSU3OFRLwrhDIxfPO9jVQDQk6hqO1RguyP762b_QJpv06a3kWB9nbAg7DI96XbIjMEkuXi7wPqEk6x4Xt0JZRfas4YzIfVIozt8r5_98r3sef8CVgCVI20qwcsok8al0OqtuXDU-liNTdx_wED-U1ACqGUMSXF12G-K2npoOvD_yynF_hAwj0Z4zgu9BOEvd61MmVeiQqjCfv6l8ppVEWfbsoCTEw13PdhwVe8WBnTSLYVjnIIqCytkqp2-eDKrFKgO7ToKv3BynepCwBUSiwH138tHY2pPd6XJaPtLBMRrqWu9nV_9hCKQyr3tuQe_zwqiyg0BWijsgIAi4R3HM1QQUVvx2DskQz8f6L91iQ7eO)

Together, we can ensure those who fight for us have someone fighting for them.

For America,

Sgt. Kevin Lincoln, USMC (vet)
Republican for Congress

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

# **17 Years Ago...**
This week marks 17 years since I became a citizen of this great nation.

**My father moves our entire family to America for a new start - we immerse in the culture, learn English, my dad drives a bus to provide for his family. We take the oath of citizenship and a few years later, his son becomes a member of the United States Congress, the first immigrant from Mexico to do so in Arizona’s history. **

Where else in the world can you have our story? Nowhere else. **_Only in America._**

**A country where I interned with a green card on Capitol Hill and returned to our nation's Capital 20 years later with a green member pin.**

I am grateful to this nation. It offered my family - and many others - the gift of opportunity. I firmly believe in the American Dream. I believe it’s alive. I am fighting to preserve that Dream for my kids and yours.

**The American Dream is a dream worth fighting for.****** Donate today to help keep up the fight for the next generation! 🇺🇸

But we've got other plans, Peter, and it starts with a little retirement party. Pelosi has been leading us down the wrong path since Ronald Reagan was in office, and it's time to send her packing. | It's time for fresh leadership that will put America first. If Pelosi won’t retire on her own accord, we’ll make the decision easy for her come Election Day. Thank you, Rep. Roger Williams TX-25 | | Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. Peter, with National Voter Registration day this week, it’s the perfect time to discuss a pressing issue destroying America’s voter integrity... According to a study by the University of Maryland earlier this year, over 7 million U.S. citizens of voting age have **no government-issued photo ID. **
That means that up to 7 million VOTERS have no way of proving their identity at the polls. _That is a massive threat to the security and accuracy of our elections._
---
[**SECURE OUR ELECTIONS**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f3662fa6cce4435ca5ac3d9466c77af0&_e=0LL9t4K2W4Z7aidS816qEjEf8gnDieyK-SeJv3_XBT96Fopk-fogmDj5glCKtYX4qYlCpFMlCZJ-d9fquDdK-BPfcTivX_pufG_RCafxYbWoMYaBpDQUlUDfp3KlqIVoJYF3u3gZos2m5hLa6CvAqZ7HcDDyzWm_w1MIH_7VR8SZ9IGTE8aVPms3qh_Dp-Bd77wxl1rOPLCDO7HFjE0VDk1YJb_T8O5yimRBj9Xh9Le-fEPX0ezHAX7WdMPoLSQ5NVR-ZlnI-k0zexiMIgFDA5lspURjIqIRbV8C_6Uf4Hm6ceSTVvoZM4EDoMSJi9yu5RTF6XQFGJQJN2vH7cla7nFvaMK0C9s0W92xgfSwLUg%3D)
---
It is important that every eligible voter can cast their ballot, but it's even more critical that fair votes don't get drowned out by fraudulent ones.
**Authenticating a voter's identity is the most fundamental step in verifying a ballot's validity. We can't allow radical activists who want to influence our elections convince us otherwise.**

body:

Friends, You wouldn’t trust Al Capone with America’s national security. Yet, the current guy in charge of our country could teach even the worst gangsters a Masterclass in crime and corruption. This is former FBI special agent Mike Rogers. I'm running for U.S. Senate — **[and with your help I’ll go to the U.S. Senate and destroy the DOJ and FBI’s rampant corruption.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zo8e4pttbmvf1g099a60cc7m6us0ke05ns1k5qeo_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm8o34c5h2bs) ** The corruption of The Big Guy sitting in the White House would make even the nastiest Chicago gangster jealous. **-Abusing state power to create multi-million dollar business deals for his family.** **-Using his power to attack his opponents and protect his family.** **-Intimidating and destroying anyone who stands in his way.** Friends, Joe Biden is no different than the petty criminals and organized crime mafiosos that I spent my career locking up. Except one thing: **Joe Biden is occupying the most powerful office in the world.** We’ve seen what happens when a mob boss leads our country. Now, I’m running for the U.S. Senate to **[dismantle the Biden Crime Family’s deep-seated network of corruption.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zl7g0grh4si797ffpcura14mvfpk4sqkvca0va18_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm8o34c5h2bs)** Just like when I went after gangsters in Chicago, I know that opposing Biden puts a huge target on my back. Biden and his corrupt minions will do anything to destroy my reputation and my career. But I can’t take a backseat as I watch the most egregious abuses of power from a president in my lifetime. Let’s fight this corruption together, Friends. Can you **[CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqqpq9l6kqfqtbpn2lfnkv1n2ctjmjs4616q9gmo_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm8o34c5h2bs)** to help send me to end the Biden Crime Family’s stranglehold on our federal law enforcement? Over the past week, we have seen firsthand the incredible power and potential of commUNITY across Harrisburg. Community activists spoke up and took a stand in support of public education, shining a light on the challenges facing black community members, and increased resources to support those in need. We rounded out the week with a celebration of Hispanic Heritage before our commUNITY barbecue.

One thing is clear to me: Healthy, informed, and connected communities are the key to progress for ALL. [Help me bring this mission to Congress by making a grassroots donation, and keep reading for detailed updates from the past week:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69966287/427886899/2145924871?amount=10&source=RC_EM_FR_WL_230918_1_1&refcode2=9d0f3476-ec56-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&contactdata=zfEdAoekEiN9hDT3DRp+opedkG3R71i4R7URK2pqECVN3nkLBeAHuig9Yiiq1hVB&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDBmMzQ3Ni1lYzU2LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jtHoiPb5Ym4jbwCq7wpT8q-LRYpTfrto71c6vzgN8oo=) | | **[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69966292/427886960/2145924871?amount=10&source=RC_EM_FR_WL_230918_1_1&refcode2=9d0f3476-ec56-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&contactdata=zfEdAoekEiN9hDT3DRp+opedkG3R71i4R7URK2pqECVN3nkLBeAHuig9Yiiq1hVB&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDBmMzQ3Ni1lYzU2LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jtHoiPb5Ym4jbwCq7wpT8q-LRYpTfrto71c6vzgN8oo=)**

Thanks to everyone who attended and supported our barbecue in Reservoir Park this weekend – it was a great success! The Scott School Positive Rappers belted out original raps entitled “Pride” and “Specials,” reminding us of the tremendous potential of our youth and our collective responsibility for their futures. Those tremendous young 4th graders spoke volumes with the power of their voices and the message on their T-shirts: “UNITY in the commUNITY.”

This event further highlights the reason I’m running for Congress: to help all our young people, and folks across PA-10, to have the bright future they deserve.

And, the work to build strong communities expands beyond our barbecue.

Last Wednesday, I joined Dr. Kimeka Campbell on her Black Newsbeat live television show, with guests Monique Bryant, Thomas Jordan, and Dr. Sharee Livingston who articulated the severe challenges facing black community members in Harrisburg as well as paths to success. I shared the story of my Mexican mother and her family's defeating racial discrimination – Her experiences and life lessons guide my thinking and actions.

The brilliance, beauty, and boundless energy of the Hispanic community were powerfully evident at the 13th Annual Hispanic Heritage Festival on Derry Street on Saturday. I listened, learned, and loved the vibe that brought back joyous childhood memories. I’ll continue to listen and learn at the PA Latino Convention in Harrisburg this week!

At the public meeting for community input on the future of the William Penn School on Monday, emotions were raw, and frustrations evident. Participants expressed not only concerns about the future of the school building but also the challenges facing Harrisburg public school students and young people seeking well-paying jobs. I stand with fellow citizens who are fighting to put our children first.

On Thursday, the amazing collaborative work of community activists and nonprofit leaders in the Dauphin County Community Partners meeting highlighted the need for immediate action to help community members who are just trying to survive. These community partners help people; they need a more effective partner in our federal government. I’m ready to be a Congressional representative who listens, learns, helps facilitate community-led solutions, and advocates effectively for federal grants to resource those efforts.

We’ve built strong momentum, but there is a lot of work ahead. I hope you’ll join our team and help me defeat Scott Perry next November. Here are a few ways you can get involved:

clean_body: | Over the past week, we have seen firsthand the incredible power and potential of commUNITY across Harrisburg. Community activists spoke up and took a stand in support of public education, shining a light on the challenges facing black community members, and increased resources to support those in need. We rounded out the week with a celebration of Hispanic Heritage before our commUNITY barbecue. One thing is clear to me: Healthy, informed, and connected communities are the key to progress for ALL. = | | = Thanks to everyone who attended and supported our barbecue in Reservoir Park this weekend – it was a great success! The Scott School Positive Rappers belted out original raps entitled “Pride” and “Specials,” reminding us of the tremendous potential of our youth and our collective responsibility for their futures. Those tremendous young 4th graders spoke volumes with the power of their voices and the message on their T-shirts: “UNITY in the commUNITY.” This event further highlights the reason I’m running for Congress: to help all our young people, and folks across PA-10, to have the bright future they deserve. And, the work to build strong communities expands beyond our barbecue. Last Wednesday, I joined Dr. Kimeka Campbell on her Black Newsbeat live television show, with guests Monique Bryant, Thomas Jordan, and Dr. Sharee Livingston who articulated the severe challenges facing black community members in Harrisburg as well as paths to success. I shared the story of my Mexican mother and her family's defeating racial discrimination – Her experiences and life lessons guide my thinking and actions. The brilliance, beauty, and boundless energy of the Hispanic community were powerfully evident at the 13th Annual Hispanic Heritage Festival on Derry Street on Saturday. I listened, learned, and loved the vibe that brought back joyous childhood memories. I’ll continue to listen and learn at the PA Latino Convention in Harrisburg this week! At the public meeting for community input on the future of the William Penn School on Monday, emotions were raw, and frustrations evident. Participants expressed not only concerns about the future of the school building but also the challenges facing Harrisburg public school students and young people seeking well-paying jobs. I stand with fellow citizens who are fighting to put our children first. On Thursday, the amazing collaborative work of community activists and nonprofit leaders in the Dauphin County Community Partners meeting highlighted the need for immediate action to help community members who are just trying to survive. These community partners help people; they need a more effective partner in our federal government. I’m ready to be a Congressional representative who listens, learns, helps facilitate community-led solutions, and advocates effectively for federal grants to resource those efforts. We’ve built strong momentum, but there is a lot of work ahead. I hope you’ll join our team and help me defeat Scott Perry next November. Here are a few ways you can get involved: Follow our campaign on and to stay up-to-date with everything happening here on the ground. * = Thanks for all you do. Onward, Rick | | | | | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Friends of Rick Coplen | =

---
| | |
---|---
Dear Friends,

Here are more details on the new budget that we have approved.

We now have $5 billion in tax reductions over the past two budgets, an amount that will produce $2,200 in tax relief to a typical Virginia family.

Much of that has or will come in the form of tax rebates, but the past two spending plans have also included major short-term changes to the standard deduction, which has nearly doubled from $4,500 to $8,500 for individuals and $9,000 to $17,000 for joint filers. And I am glad we were able to help families even more by restoring the sales tax holiday.

Other investments in this budget include $200 million to help prepare sites for large-scale economic development projects, $653 million in new education spending, $170 million in behavioral health investments to further Youngkin's "Right Help, Right Now" plan and $671 million in natural resources spending.

This is one of the few budgets that I've voted in favor of over the past 8 years.

For God & Country,
Amanda Chase

subject: Why I asked for your old furniture
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Friend, you may have seen me asking for your old furniture a few weeks ago:
Well, I’m happy to announce that the Leaders We Deserve office is 100% volunteer-furnished thanks to the help of some incredibly kind supporters in the DC area! 🎉 What does this have to do with you? Keep reading ⬇️
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
I asked for donations of old furniture because, to be honest, I didn’t want to spend your hard-earned dollars on fancy chairs or whatever. That’s not what we’re about. Leaders We Deserve is all-in on our mission to elect young leaders across America, so we’re going to spend as much of our budget on that mission as possible. And we’re proud to have Serve America's support in this mission.
Now that we’re all set on furniture, we’re focusing on growing our grassroots movement to elect more young people across the country. We’re still counting on your support, so will you split a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Serve America to help? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
This fight isn’t just about this election cycle. It’s about changing the face of our government forever by electing young leaders who are capable of bringing sorely needed change that will last for generations. By splitting a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Serve America today, you’re investing in this movement for the long haul.
But in order for us to move the needle, this work depends on grassroots supporters like you. Whether it’s $5 or $50, every contribution counts.
Please consider splitting a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Serve America today to fund the hard work ahead of us (not to buy fancy office chairs). [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
More soon,
David Hogg Co-Founder, Leaders We Deserve
P.S. You might be wondering why I was wearing a suit moving furniture in 95F. The day we got to move in I had a meeting at the White House, so in the middle of my U-Hauling around D.C., I had to go to that meeting, and then continue moving our stuff up several stories. (I need to find a good dry cleaner in D.C.)

This will be a fun-filled evening for a great cause, fundraising for the Common Sense Club!

---
| Here's a little more on our featured comedians for the evening: **Fred Rubino,** born in Manhattan and raised in Brooklyn, developed his comedy material from the humor and experiences of growing up Italian in Brooklyn. He's opened for notable comics such as Nick Dipaolo and Vic Dibitetto, quickly becoming a sought-after featured comedian. Rubino has showcased his humor on Radio Opie and Anthony's show, had performances live-streamed via Action Audio, and frequently appeared on local cable talk shows. **Gary G. Garcia,** a modern-day renaissance man with experience in music and clothing design, has focused on stand-up comedy over the past five years. Having started in the New York City comedy scene, he often performs at the Grisly Pear in NYC and in Atlantic City with ACJokes.com. His distinctive raspy voice paired with his straightforward humor is memorable. Gary can be found in Astoria, Queens, where he's often proudly speaking of his children. **We hope you'll join us for an evening bursting with laughter, all in support of the Common Sense Club's fundraising efforts!** See you soon, Bill & The Common Sense Action Team
---
|

Many arrogant, elitist elected officials crushed our way of life during the misguided, unnecessary and deadly lockdowns. Now it’s time to hold them accountable for their actions, ignorance and negligence. The tide is turning, and today is only STEP ONE!

This year’s elections provide a can’t-miss opportunity to support small businesses and families with fiscally responsible policies, restore an education system that puts students and parents over the radical agenda of the NJEA elites, and protect and preserve our civil, economic, and medical liberty.
We believe that our government should serve the people and provide the expected services that we’re paying for! It’s time for government to function as a public service, not a propaganda tool for radicals.
We believe in REDUCING tax burdens on working families AND empowering the skilled trades and small businesses.
We believe our schools should reject Critical Race Theory and the sexualized curricula. It’s time to empower parents and stop the NJEA once and for all.
I hope you’ll join me TODAY as we discuss the results of this year’s critical elections.
If you want to stand with me against the out-of-touch career politicians who are taking New Jersey down the wrong path and help restore Common Sense, you’re in the right place!Please join me during my show tonight, call in to share your thoughts, and watch the results of this year’s elections live as they come in!
Together, we can keep working to restore Common Sense and save New Jersey and America.
Thank you,Bill Spadea

I never thought that my own government would spy on me.

I have always loved my country.

That's why I've dedicated my life to being a public defender, a federal prosecutor, and a legal liaison to the United States Armed Forces. I believe in the foundational values of America - life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.

So when Devin Nunes asked me to help with the Russiagate investigation, I told him whatever we discovered about President Trump, _good or bad_ , it had to be published.

When I started my investigation, I hadn't even met President Trump. **But this investigation changed my life forever ...**

_Trump did NOT collude with Russia_.

**My investigation discovered the FBI 's unlawful investigation. And what I found makes me believe that they did it _intentionall_ y to get rid of President Trump.**

It's why I refer to the Russia Gate FBI cabal as government gangsters. They are crooks who abuse their power to extort our elected officials. Their deep connections with the media enable a manufacturing machine of fake news.

Once I found the truth, that's when the spying began...

Since then, I knew I had to do everything to help American patriots by offering financial assistance to whistleblowers, veterans, patriots, and some families of Jan 6 detainees.

As a former federal prosecutor, I know that we need protection if we are going to expose corrupt government gangsters.

I set a goal to raise **$45,000** by the end of the week, and we're behind in reaching that goal.

Some of the Jan 6 detainees have become victims of the abuses outlined above, and we cannot leave them in solitary confinement within the D.C. prison system.

**This two-tiered justice system is a complete sham and a mockery of our constitution.**

Due process has been destroyed.

**We cannot let the justice system be hijacked and used against us. **

[I am humbly asking for your support. Join me in the fight for justice in defending patriots against abuse of the justice system by clicking here >>>](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zqd4c4fcefbbp4r6nqeh7slkk2g4oj4qut19llk8_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgmaob7cph2bs)

Trump and the Jan 6 defendants are only the beginning. The radical left has weaponized the justice system against America-first patriots.

Whether you're a whistleblower exposing deep state corruption, a parent protesting against trans ideology in our schools, or a pro-life activist praying outside of abortion clinics, the justice system can be used against you. Fellow American,

My name is Kevin Lincoln. I’m a proud United States Marine Corps veteran, and I’m a conservative Republican running for Congress in California’s competitive 9th district.

I joined the Marine Corps in 2001 and became a military police officer. In the aftermath of the September 11th attacks, I was assigned to the White House Military Office attached to the Marine One aircraft – _an assignment of great honor and great responsibility._

**Our mission was to protect and securely transport the President of the United States following the attack on our country.**

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=39b0aa56c49c4d42acc3f4d9a4e6a496&_e=5om9Z__W4AaB3ivHvz2T6GvqwHOQADMf56VF4EZb-zs9vBid9ZWEjLxp5JhhYZUDKD6nlWMrgSjEvTJb4MNSUsjkT6XAPk6h1eay7O3qAVxfNq7zBX8SECk3mvdMpe9o4mBcCqQ88kgiIn77hKvgwTUpINByggtYvQIbL0D4xeeRAuo8AxcMUvaQi42_5eJRi_KYrs4n00GFpfASaDA-G7yYwW5_ea77x9E8JYzJPX7MVIYkh5M4x9KBe7cxFKz8E7gV65riXejT0qdm9WdoWpwTQFbvI9dfPcds-mEZZnqpl_q7NBlo8Bk5Uo9cmJ9DswAe9GWb_q2xTBGxvA2SHgQG6EjfQOy7AaTdTL7OGskK05pVzOH90wxIU8Zo24p5)
**Now, I’m stepping up to serve my country again – this time in the House of Representatives.**

[ ** Send a Marine to Congress ➞ **](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=39b0aa56c49c4d42acc3f4d9a4e6a496&_e=5om9Z__W4AaB3ivHvz2T6GvqwHOQADMf56VF4EZb-zs9vBid9ZWEjLxp5JhhYZUDKD6nlWMrgSjEvTJb4MNSUsjkT6XAPk6h1eay7O3qAVxfNq7zBX8SECk3mvdMpe9o4mBcCqQ88kgiIn77hKvgwTUpINByggtYvQIbL0D4xeeRAuo8AxcMUvaQi42_5eJRi_KYrs4n00GFpfASaDA-G7yYwW5_ea77x9E8JYzJPX5XtWdBZ2VTMEeT4FkX92OkAkWIOQ2DGooiz50njyGAgb2fASx9tzcwFTDwCTURllm1jvKHWPrrn1t6KA_p2dTBJWvZqpRQUqMcTlOltCOpFa0tmpwzPPoR-hiMovuMBM94yLXUiYQ1w65NDDhbm2fR)
My incumbent Democrat opponent, Josh Harder, is not serving our country. He has failed not just our district, but also those who wear the uniform.

Harder voted AGAINST protecting critical benefits for our veterans and AGAINST raising the pay of our active-duty service men and women. _This is unacceptable!_

**Together, Harder and Biden have failed our veterans and our military.**

**Those who serve our country, along with their families, deserve so much better. In Congress, I will make protecting veterans’ benefits and raising military pay among my top priorities.**

[**If you support our veterans and active-duty military, will you ensure they have a voice in Congress by supporting my campaign with a contribution of $10, $25, $50 or more today?**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=39b0aa56c49c4d42acc3f4d9a4e6a496&_e=5om9Z__W4AaB3ivHvz2T6GvqwHOQADMf56VF4EZb-zs9vBid9ZWEjLxp5JhhYZUDKD6nlWMrgSjEvTJb4MNSUsjkT6XAPk6h1eay7O3qAVxfNq7zBX8SECk3mvdMpe9o4mBcCqQ88kgiIn77hKvgwTUpINByggtYvQIbL0D4xeeRAuo8AxcMUvaQi42_5eJRi_KYrs4n00GFpfASaDA-G7yYwW5_ea77x9E8JYzJPX5weVBMhRU5bhbcb14lXpeNco1Xa4MKSyuONAPMseOplj24ruVqkQjREIv4SCqZs3ad8HN3F0nkJLmPxrSRCB3ia6M5TiljT7WeKhqSnCiaUk8pPt6Pl12Im1yMWyrP-oKa_0EtGokFoGp5T--_bDEo)

Together, we can ensure those who fight for us have someone fighting for them.

For America,

Sgt. Kevin Lincoln, USMC (vet)
Republican for Congress

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

name: Alex Padilla
subject: Are you registered to vote?
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
#

Happy National Voter Registration Day! 🎉🎉🎉
You may not know this about me, but before I became U.S. Senator for California, I served as California’s Secretary of State.
[](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/3184?refcode=em230919-1-30%2Fap-em-sep23%3Frefcode%3Dem230919-1-subs&t=1&akid=1535%2E159979%2E9PA6wE)
_It’s an old photo, but you can still go to[**RegisterToVote.ca.gov](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/3180?c0=ap-em-sep23.kjQr8D&refcode=em230919-1-subs&t=2&akid=1535%2E159979%2E9PA6wE)_**
In most states, including California, that’s the person responsible for running free and fair elections -- ensuring that everyone who’s eligible to vote gets to exercise that constitutional right to make their voice heard and participate in our democracy.
It’s an important job, and one I was proud to do for the people of California. We made elections more accessible, established automatic and same-day voter registration, and expanded mail-in and in-person voting.
We did that because I believe, and I hope you do too, that our democracy is only at its strongest when everyone — no matter what zip code they live in or the color of their skin — is able to make their voice heard and play a part in shaping our collective future.
So today, I’m asking you to register to vote. You can use the link from my sign above ([**RegisterToVote.ca.gov](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/3180?c0=ap-em-sep23.kjQr8D&refcode=em230919-1-subs&t=3&akid=1535%2E159979%2E9PA6wE)**). Or if you’re already registered, find a friend or family member who isn’t, and get them registered to vote. **
Thank you for reading, and for making sure you’re registered to vote!
Alex Padilla
U.S. Senator for California
Former Secretary of State of California
* * *
👋🏽 Before you go! 👋🏽
Alex Padilla is the son of immigrants, and California’s first Latino U.S. Senator. Now, he’s working hard to ensure that ALL Americans can achieve the American Dream — **no matter where they were born or what neighborhood they live in.**
[**Can you please make a $3 donation to support Alex? He’s counting on grassroots supporters like us to help hit his goals and ensure he has the resources to support Democrats in California and across the country.](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-sep23.CPAJpI&refcode=em230919-1-subs&t=4&akid=1535%2E159979%2E9PA6wE)**

clean_body: Happy National Voter Registration Day! 🎉🎉🎉 You may not know this about me, but before I became U.S. Senator for California, I served as California’s Secretary of State. It’s an old photo, but you can still go to In most states, including California, that’s the person responsible for running free and fair elections -- ensuring that everyone who’s eligible to vote gets to exercise that constitutional right to make their voice heard and participate in our democracy. It’s an important job, and one I was proud to do for the people of California. We made elections more accessible, established automatic and same-day voter registration, and expanded mail-in and in-person voting. We did that because I believe, and I hope you do too, that our democracy is only at its strongest when everyone — no matter what zip code they live in or the color of their skin — is able to make their voice heard and play a part in shaping our collective future. So today, I’m asking you to register to vote. You can use the link from my sign above (). Or if you’re already registered, find a friend or family member who isn’t, and get them registered to vote. name: Margaret Mary Dunn
subject: Thrown in jail by the woke mob?
body:
I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

Michael is a police officer who dedicated his life to keeping our community safe in Farmers Branch, Texas.

_**But now he might be facing a life sentence in prison for shooting a dangerous career criminal who tried to run Michael down in a stolen truck.**_

[**Will you help my son?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjf87nqqtn5459kuj69likl0r06js35q0v1sj83g_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm6ob6cth2bs)

That's Michael in the photo.

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zr898b8gd0mg1btpq9vcflui8ghbrod2mt96rc88_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm6ob6cth2bs) [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zkotrvq1lbma9d866jq1rhgqbkienude79n96h30_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm6ob6cth2bs)

In addition to being a police officer, Michael is also a Master Gunnery Sergeant in the United Stated Marine Corps Reserve.

I knew when he joined the police department that it was a dangerous job.

Every night on the news I saw another story of a police officer ambushed or killed in the line of duty.

It's been a heart wrenching time for the families of police officers in recent years.

What I didn't expect was that so many Americans would turn their backs on Michael in his time of need.

I now realize that it's all about fear. Fear of being attacked as a racist.

Fear of going against woke politicians and bureaucrats.

Fear of losing their jobs.

I assumed that the police department, the prosecutor's office, and everyone else in the government and the community would have Michael's back.

**But I was wrong.**

_So_ _now_ _Michael 's_ _life_ _is_ _at_ _stake_ _for_ _simply_ _doing_ _his_ _job_ _and_ _we_ _have_ _nobody_ _to_ _turn_ _to_ _except_ _for_ _good_ _hearted_ _strangers_ _like_ _you._

**[Will you please help me save my son Michael?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpr0jv55k69rri8difo3imkrvi6b4kbd4891mmo8_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm6ob6cth2bs)**

Let me give you some more of the details...

Michael and other Farmers Branch Police detectives tracked a stolen pickup truck to the parking lot of an "adult arcade."

The truck was stolen by a convicted felon who was well-known to the police.

Michael was assigned the task of arresting this man.

When the suspect came back to the truck, Michael pulled up and stepped out of his police car.

The criminal sped the stolen truck toward him.

Michael had to do what every police officer hopes they never have to do: he drew his weapon and fired.

The man driving the stolen truck died at the scene.

My son suffered back and leg injuries.

Michael had a split-second to think about if the career criminal speeding toward him was going to crush him to death with that stolen truck.

In that split-second, he did what he needed to do in order to save his own life and the lives of his fellow officers and community.

There's no doubt in my mind, and many others, that Michael made the right choice that day.

He should be considered a hero for putting his life on the line to protect others.

But right and wrong seem to have been turned upside down in the last few years.

Why else would they be trying to put my son in prison for murder for what he did?

That's why I'm willing to do whatever it takes to clear his name. **[Even if that means asking folks like you for financial support to help my son afford the best possible attorneys and legal advice.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ztkuattitfmtf72c097lcbrlh5ct91hr2cmsv378_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm6ob6cth2bs)**

After the incident, Michael was distraught to hear the criminal died.

But the other officers assured him the shooting was justified.

And then our whole world was rocked.

**Just 8 days after the incident Michael was indicted.**

Experts described the indictment as "unusually swift." The president of the Dallas Police Association said:

"We have never had an investigation completed in less than eight days ready to hand over to the District Attorney. Never."

I knew in my heart something was wrong - and we would be facing the fight of our lives to defend Michael in court.

We started a fundraising campaign on the internet site "GoFundMe" to raise money for a proper legal defense.

After a few days, "GoFundMe" shut down the fundraiser.

They claimed Michael's actions as a police officer were an "act of hate" \- and helping him violated their terms of service.

So in this anti-police climate, politically woke climate, the case was closed in their minds.

No "innocent until proven guilty." No due process.

Instead, my son was smeared as a "murderer" who committed a "hate crime."

Since then, my husband and I spent half our life savings on legal fees and bills to help Michael.

_With the investigation devastating my family... seeing Michael, an American hero, being smeared on the internet... and our family quickly running out of money to pay mounting court fees... hope was fading._

Until we heard about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). **LELDF is the best friend a police officer could ever have.**

LELDF defends good officers, like my son, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.

The group's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.

And praise the Lord, LELDF saw it fit to help my son!

**[Will you please consider sending a tax-deductible contribution to the LELDF so they can help my son beat his charges?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmuu9t7euhcvsrlf4mkbho1tsj6usdgi8ui4dsf0_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm6ob6cth2bs)**

You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. It doesn't receive any funds from the government to help our police officers.

Or, if the Lord has blessed you with the means to help with a **[gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more,](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0de5ia6q026vjk0sqfvdt0v663f4tl9iim6at90_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm6ob6cth2bs)** I pray you will consider doing so.

Please know any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing.

If you can't help financially today, I understand. And please keep Michael and our family in your prayers.

My son Michael is an American hero who served our nation and his community. He shouldn't be locked behind bars for defending his life from a career criminal.
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2za531k9intliui43vt3bq9adjbrf6fdqp442aduo_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm6ob6cth2bs)
_That 's a picture of Michael with his daughter - my granddaughter - Mary-Kaitlyn_
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6aslqhfqj3upg1u9kd2auskcvrgomojil1f5hn0_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm6ob6cth2bs)
_That 's a picture of Michael with his Son - my grandson - William_

I pray you never go through something like this. But if you do, may God touch the hearts of kind people to help you - just as I'm praying He'll touch your heart to help my son today.

Sincerely,

Margaret Mary Dunn

PS: LELDF relies on caring people like you to send donations so they can fight tooth and nail to help wrongly-accused police officers like Michael. And because LELDF is a non-profit, all donations are tax-deductible. Your kind **[donation today of $35, $50, or $100](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zr0grtf1a2110r7f9i6lpleua0ucpve9ehbaort8_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm6ob6cth2bs)** to help Michael will mean so much to my family.

\----------------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.leldf.org**. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_
_(C) Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | www.PoliceDefense.org
2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303_

ICYMI News

body:
We’ll always support unions, and that’s why all of our merchandise is union made.
# [](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/39?t=1&akid=117%2E1163%2EmMLANd)
Friend, our campaign is loudly + proudly pro-union, pro-worker, and pro-labor rights. ([**Pssst! If you’re with us there**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230918?amount=10&refcode=em20230918-1&refcode2=117_1163_mMLANd&akid=117%2E1163%2EmMLANd)[**— and want to send a fighter for working people to Congress**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230918?amount=10&refcode=em20230918-1&refcode2=117_1163_mMLANd&akid=117%2E1163%2EmMLANd)[**— we hope you’ll chip in $10 right now to help us close a fundraising gap that’s getting bigger as we approach our end-of-month deadline**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230918?amount=10&refcode=em20230918-1&refcode2=117_1163_mMLANd&akid=117%2E1163%2EmMLANd)[.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230918?amount=10&refcode=em20230918-1&refcode2=117_1163_mMLANd&akid=117%2E1163%2EmMLANd))
As a single mother, Lateefah knows just how difficult it can be to balance work, family obligations, and the struggle of working long hard hours to put food on the table.
**Workers’ rights are something that our campaign will never compromise on!**
That’s why every piece of merchandise that our campaign creates, designs, and produces, has a little symbol at the bottom. If you’ve received one of our t-shirts at an event or posted one of our signs in your window, you’ve probably seen it!
**Here! Look closely at that the symbol underneath our logo on this Lateefah for Congress shirt:**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230918?amount=10&refcode=em20230918-1&refcode2=117_1163_mMLANd&akid=117%2E1163%2EmMLANd)
That symbol on the shirt is called a union bug and it’s there because **every campaign t-shirt is made by union printers here in CA-12** — and that’s something that we’re so proud of!
Every worker deserves to have the pay and benefits that unions can help them achieve. Collective bargaining and protection in a workplace is invariably and can make all the difference for workers’ lives.
But here’s the thing, in all transparency it’s a lot more expensive to order from union printers. That’s the way it SHOULD be, because getting quality merch from partners who pay their people well is just more expensive.
But here’s the thing: We’re behind on our fundraising for this month, and we want to be able to print out more merch before the end of this month and the end of the quarter.
[**That’s why we have to ask, can you donate $10 or more to our campaign right now to help us have the resources we need to continue to support local union workers?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230918?amount=10&refcode=em20230918-1&refcode2=117_1163_mMLANd&akid=117%2E1163%2EmMLANd)
**[Donate $10 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230918?amount=10&refcode=em20230918-1&refcode2=117_1163_mMLANd&akid=117%2E1163%2EmMLANd)**
Supporting organized labor never goes out of style! ✊🏿
Thank you for supporting our pro-labor movement,
Team Lateefah
P.S. If you want your very own union made Team Lateefah t-shirt, we’ll have lots at our upcoming event at Oakland’s Home of Chicken and Waffles. [**Tickets for the Oct. 5th event are still available but going fast so click the link here and secure yours today.**](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/405?t=2&akid=117%2E1163%2EmMLANd)
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-wrapper?refcode=em20230918-1&t=3&refcode2=117_1163_mMLANd&akid=117%2E1163%2EmMLANd)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:

* [Unsubscribe](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=5&akid=117%2E1163%2EmMLANd)

To give by check:
Lateefah for Congress
1714 Franklin St #100 - 438,
Oakland, CA, 94612
Email us: [info@lateefahsimon.com](mailto:info@lateefahsimon.com)

Friend, my journey to Congress looks a bit different than most.

**My mom was my biggest hero growing up.** She raised me on her own in Dallas, and I spent most afternoons at the local YMCA while she worked a second job to make ends meet. With a lot of hard work and support from my mom, coaches, and teachers, I earned a full football scholarship to Baylor and went on to play in the NFL.

Then, I went to law school, became a civil rights attorney to protect voting rights, and served in the Obama administration.

I ran for Congress because I don’t want my story to be the exception – **I want all kids to have every opportunity to achieve their dreams.**

**Now, I’m running for Senate because I’m sick and tired of watching Ted Cruz fail Texas kids and families. And experts agree we can win – since launching our campaign, both Roll Call and the Cook Political Report have increased our chances.**

**But it’s going to take the biggest grassroots movement Texas has ever seen, and I need you to be a part of it, friend.
