name: Jennifer Grossman
subject: My time with Jeffrey Epstein
body:
My story of meeting Jeffrey Epstein is unusual.

[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23836%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hBzJkIgojC0KDmoraAhFOQ&sysid=1)
Friend,

My story of meeting Jeffrey Epstein is unusual. Fortunately for me, I didn’t end up one of his victims. At the time, I was 27 years old and, by then, too old and well-connected (and protected) for his tastes.

We met in Aspen, Colorado. He was charming, funny, and attentive. He offered me a ride back to NYC on his private jet. With several friends in common, I had no reason to suspect the darkness that hid behind his glamorous facade.

Shortly thereafter, he invited me down to his palatial estate in Palm Beach, but once I arrived, I knew something was wrong. He was naked in his pool, making calls. When I declined to similarly disrobe, he started making vulgar remarks about my bathing suit and make-up.

**Before I tell you the rest of my story, allow me to introduce myself _(Please keep reading)_.**

My name is Jennifer Grossman (JAG), and I serve as the CEO of The Atlas Society. Our mission is to engage young people with the ideas of Ayn Rand in creative ways to equip the next generation with the virtues of reason, productivity, and achievement.

In a world in which young women, in particular, are vulnerable to the irrational, destructive woke agenda of the left--peddling victimhood, envy, resentment, fear, and entitlement--Ayn Rand’s inspiring female protagonists and her empowering message of individualism and freedom, can help young women defend themselves against predators, whether dangerous deviants like Jeffrey Epstein, or predatory leftists seeking to prey on gullibility to amass power.

**[You can support The Atlas Society’s mission by donating $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or ANY amount by clicking here>>>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23837%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4Z%2fppNs4DZakUX6FnItRvQ&sysid=1)**

**The rest of my story with Jeffrey Epstein: ⬇️⬇️⬇️**

Fortunately, I believe Epstein recognized I was not a suitable candidate to become one of his victims. At 27 years old, I was already 13 years older than his oldest victim.

Predators like Epstein are also experts at recognizing the weak and vulnerable--and avoiding those with experience and resources.

**Why am I telling you this story, and how does it relate to our mission at The Atlas Society?**

Here’s the ugly truth: The story of Jeffrey Epstein is about more than perversion and predation. **It’s about power** -- gaining power over his victims and wielding power over the rich and powerful he hoped to ensnare in his network.

His strategy was all about finding shortcuts, cutting corners, and manipulating others. He didn’t seek productive win-win relationships with equals but rather sought to bring others (girls and peers) down to his own depraved level. He didn’t seek to live with integrity -- he sought to destroy it in others.

It’s the absolute antithesis of the vision presented in Ayn Rand’s novels like _Atlas Shrugged_ and _The Fountainhead_ , where heroic entrepreneurs and independent creative geniuses pursue lives of productivity and integrity.

Even critics of Ayn Rand’s fiction acknowledge that her villains are eerily accurate characterizations of the moochers, looters, and second-handers we see around us -- people trying to get something for nothing, not by bringing their best efforts and ideas to the table, but by promoting fear and victimhood to exploit others.

**At The Atlas Society, we’re helping young people recognize -- and defend themselves -- against such parasites.**

In a day and age where daily book reading has plummeted 85% since the late 1970s, we introduce young people to Rand’s philosophy of individualism, honesty, and responsibility through wildly creative means such as graphic novels, animated videos, edgy social media, as well as weekly events and our annual student conference.

[I am asking you to consider supporting The Atlas Society’s mission by helping us reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors in the next 48 hours. Can I count on your support? Please use one of the links below to make an URGENT donation.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23838%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=snWAgwVD6J83oK%2fvRQonsA&sysid=1)

[Donate $50 >>>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23831%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=baHYuz3BQPXC9IA4%2fJl1BA&sysid=1)
[Donate $100 >>>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23832%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vz71PD8tBBdO0FgxDLBxsA&sysid=1)
[Donate $250 >>>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23833%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=c8gqWGd4CDklMDdHvbmeFA&sysid=1)
[Donate $500 >>>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23834%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FIDZ7gC%2ban1OsWqQRCTl8w&sysid=1)
[Donate $1,000 >>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23845%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kbPDZO%2bSdJUzx%2ffHk48%2fmg&sysid=1)
[Donate ANY Amount >>>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23846%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=x6KM%2fpJhS2Jt6c4%2f8qybFA&sysid=1)

**The Jeffrey Epstein story isn’t over yet:**

Here are two of his greatest unsolved mysteries:
* How did he acquire his wealth?
* Who were his conspirators, and why haven’t they been identified?

We may never have these answers as insiders, our corrupt justice system, and some big names do NOT want us to discover the truth.

Yes, Jeffrey Epstein is dead.

However, corrupt men like Jeffrey Epstein continue to live at large and use blackmail, fraud, and the evils of big government to obtain money, fame, and power.

The Atlas Society and Ayn Rand’s message provides the next generation with a different path, hope, and a brighter future.

You and I MUST reject the status quo.

**Ideas like socialism and big government aren’t just bad ... They are evil!**

We must stop believing that the use of force to obtain money, power, and fame is the answer to any of our problems.

[Please join The Atlas Society and help us spread our message of reason, capitalism, rational self-interest, and achievement by making a donation. You can click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or ANY amount. ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23847%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xY8w%2f2CgAiN8jCqgNLxbjw&sysid=1)

Reminder: Our goal is to raise $25,000 from new online supporters in the next 48 hours. So please make your donation before you do anything else today.

Thank you,

Jennifer Grossman (JAG)
CEO
The Atlas Society

name: Margaret Mary Dunn
subject: My hero son is facing life in prison
body:
I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

Michael is a police officer who dedicated his life to keeping our community safe in Farmers Branch, Texas.

_**But now he might be facing a life sentence in prison for shooting a dangerous career criminal who tried to run Michael down in a stolen truck.**_

[**Will you help my son?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhcofdb0v9m0vha4ggcngvjphb0citbrjn6fksto_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm1oj2clh2bs)

That's Michael in the photo.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zaa4rknbdhgkp3jdhtgboo1drpjvaugh2okvdns8_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm1oj2clh2bs) [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs82eje6vg1ht6oh60qg8b6sm0ad7pu8s1ka9dlg_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm1oj2clh2bs)

In addition to being a police officer, Michael is also a Master Gunnery Sergeant in the United Stated Marine Corps Reserve.

I knew when he joined the police department that it was a dangerous job.

Every night on the news I saw another story of a police officer ambushed or killed in the line of duty.

It's been a heart wrenching time for the families of police officers in recent years.

What I didn't expect was that so many Americans would turn their backs on Michael in his time of need.

I now realize that it's all about fear. Fear of being attacked as a racist.

Fear of going against woke politicians and bureaucrats.

Fear of losing their jobs.

I assumed that the police department, the prosecutor's office, and everyone else in the government and the community would have Michael's back.

**But I was wrong.**

_So_ _now_ _Michael 's_ _life_ _is_ _at_ _stake_ _for_ _simply_ _doing_ _his_ _job_ _and_ _we_ _have_ _nobody_ _to_ _turn_ _to_ _except_ _for_ _good_ _hearted_ _strangers_ _like_ _you._

**[Will you please help me save my son Michael?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5f94uqb8njuejvul6gib1l6bhn2l2n28sjovq0o_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm1oj2clh2bs)**

Let me give you some more of the details...

Michael and other Farmers Branch Police detectives tracked a stolen pickup truck to the parking lot of an "adult arcade."

The truck was stolen by a convicted felon who was well-known to the police.

Michael was assigned the task of arresting this man.

When the suspect came back to the truck, Michael pulled up and stepped out of his police car.

The criminal sped the stolen truck toward him.

Michael had to do what every police officer hopes they never have to do: he drew his weapon and fired.

The man driving the stolen truck died at the scene.

My son suffered back and leg injuries.

Michael had a split-second to think about if the career criminal speeding toward him was going to crush him to death with that stolen truck.

In that split-second, he did what he needed to do in order to save his own life and the lives of his fellow officers and community.

There's no doubt in my mind, and many others, that Michael made the right choice that day.

He should be considered a hero for putting his life on the line to protect others.

But right and wrong seem to have been turned upside down in the last few years.

Why else would they be trying to put my son in prison for murder for what he did?

That's why I'm willing to do whatever it takes to clear his name. **[Even if that means asking folks like you for financial support to help my son afford the best possible attorneys and legal advice.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp5ibt80i0bhh42d2f4l431a8nh75vk1qqbatnc8_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm1oj2clh2bs)**

After the incident, Michael was distraught to hear the criminal died.

But the other officers assured him the shooting was justified.

And then our whole world was rocked.

**Just 8 days after the incident Michael was indicted.**

Experts described the indictment as "unusually swift." The president of the Dallas Police Association said:

"We have never had an investigation completed in less than eight days ready to hand over to the District Attorney. Never."

I knew in my heart something was wrong - and we would be facing the fight of our lives to defend Michael in court.

We started a fundraising campaign on the internet site "GoFundMe" to raise money for a proper legal defense.

After a few days, "GoFundMe" shut down the fundraiser.

They claimed Michael's actions as a police officer were an "act of hate" \- and helping him violated their terms of service.

So in this anti-police climate, politically woke climate, the case was closed in their minds.

No "innocent until proven guilty." No due process.

Instead, my son was smeared as a "murderer" who committed a "hate crime."

Since then, my husband and I spent half our life savings on legal fees and bills to help Michael.

_With the investigation devastating my family... seeing Michael, an American hero, being smeared on the internet... and our family quickly running out of money to pay mounting court fees... hope was fading._

Until we heard about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). **LELDF is the best friend a police officer could ever have.**

LELDF defends good officers, like my son, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.

The group's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.

And praise the Lord, LELDF saw it fit to help my son!

**[Will you please consider sending a tax-deductible contribution to the LELDF so they can help my son beat his charges?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2ufdsmrnt35tg2un207tltc55kgr197o4h290ko_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm1oj2clh2bs)**

You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. It doesn't receive any funds from the government to help our police officers.

Or, if the Lord has blessed you with the means to help with a **[gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more,](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6p8g9j76b4n3rh566oeaq2jn6pffg789vscpjpg_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm1oj2clh2bs)** I pray you will consider doing so.

Please know any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing.

If you can't help financially today, I understand. And please keep Michael and our family in your prayers.

My son Michael is an American hero who served our nation and his community. He shouldn't be locked behind bars for defending his life from a career criminal.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsjc7lhuda8hae5rsde49eokguqqkatqh3vg7rgg_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm1oj2clh2bs)
_That 's a picture of Michael with his daughter - my granddaughter - Mary-Kaitlyn_
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zg4ih1r02nhds7eeeme0pioqifbfaa60oleugoe8_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm1oj2clh2bs)
_That 's a picture of Michael with his Son - my grandson - William_

I pray you never go through something like this. But if you do, may God touch the hearts of kind people to help you - just as I'm praying He'll touch your heart to help my son today.

Sincerely,

Margaret Mary Dunn

PS: LELDF relies on caring people like you to send donations so they can fight tooth and nail to help wrongly-accused police officers like Michael. And because LELDF is a non-profit, all donations are tax-deductible. Your kind **[donation today of $35, $50, or $100](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4nm4lar5don94llrrs7mumvn03ip2hbiqsm0c7o_rp22sh2s8i66p75chgm1oj2clh2bs)** to help Michael will mean so much to my family.

\----------------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.leldf.org**. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_
_(C) Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | www.PoliceDefense.org
2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303_

| | | | | Peter, Lauren Boebert is unfit to attend live performances, much less represent Americans in Congress. Boebert attended a showing of Beetlejuice in Denver, and her behavior was so outrageous and inappropriate she had to be physically escorted out of the theater. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5237aef9-2fe5-4373-8a92-344f31086524/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _The supposed paragon of family values, while at a show recommended to kids as young as 10, openly groped her date, who groped her back. She vaped–which she lied about until video proved it–even after a pregnant woman sitting behind her asked her to stop. She made loud noises and took pictures, both against the rules, and yelled profanities at those who had to escort her out._ You may recall Blue Amp Action supported her opponent, Adam Frisch, early in 2022 when pundits said it was unwinnable. Well, after losing by only 546 votes in the closest House race in the country, Frisch is back, and in recent polling leads Boebert by 2%! [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T13b232a4-c4fa-4181-a42e-f0ab56ef452b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) We can win and rid ourselves of this cringeworthy Congresswoman, a right-wing nut who wants to ban all abortion and thinks we need more assault rifles. But we need your help! [Can you join us in giving $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can to Frisch for Congress, a race that could return us to a majority in the House?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb1c86b13-b45d-43f1-89d3-63f5261979bc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for your dedication, as always.
Cliff

I’m excited to announce that I’m here in Washington, D.C. to launch the national campaign to term-limit members of the United States Supreme Court, and I hope you have a few seconds to learn about what we want to accomplish and how you can help us do it.

There are term limits for presidents, governors, state legislators, and local officials — but not members of the Supreme Court who are appointed for life. It’s common sense that there is an extreme risk of corruption for someone with a lifetime appointment in one of the most powerful positions in our government with almost no accountability — and that’s just what we’re seeing today.

**Ethics scandals embroil members of the Court — some of whom have served for more than 40 years. And with rulings handed down that throw out 50 years of legal precedent — it’s no wonder the public is losing confidence. That’s why we’re working to restore integrity to the Court by pushing Congress to pass legislation to enact term limits. But to do that, we need your help.**

**[That's why I wanted to personally ask if you could help give Term Limit The Court the boost it needs to help us reach our Launch Day fundraising goal of $25,000. Can you pitch in right now to become a Founding Donor?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69981425/427941802/1073183183?refcode2=7c2a0356-fe56-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emci=9dbdf868-f556-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=7c2a0356-fe56-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&amount=5&refcode=091923-es-tltc-launch-fr-1-eod&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS8xMDE4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2MyYTAzNTYtZmU1Ni1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ll-vr71x04YxkoP73R4Yd266EnkxreCBzlJ3-AInpSE=)**

name: Costello for Senate Newsletter
subject: Fwd: Why I’m Running for the U.S. Senate v Senator King
body:
Dear Friend,

I just wanted to share with you an email that we sent out to Maine democrats today explaining David's reasoning behind running for the U.S. Senate.
Feel free to take a look at that below and, as always, check out our website ([www.costelloforsenate.com](http://www.costelloforsenate.com)) and social media accounts ([www.instagram.com/costelloforsenate](http://www.instagram.com/costelloforsenate) and [www.twitter.com/costello4senate](http://www.twitter.com/costello4senate)) for more information about the campaign.

Thank you,
Grace

\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: **David Costello** <[costellodavida37@gmail.com](mailto:costellodavida37@gmail.com)>
Date: Tue, Sep 19, 2023 at 1:24 PM
Subject: Why I’m Running for the U.S. Senate v Senator King
To: <[campaign@costelloforsenate.com](mailto:campaign@costelloforsenate.com)>

Dear Maine Democrat:
Over this past summer I’ve had the opportunity to speak with many Maine voters about the state of our economy and democracy, and the performance of our government. And, like me, many expressed the concern that our federal government isn’t doing enough to address our most demanding challenges. Which gets to the root of why I’m running against Senator King.
I decided to run because I’m concerned that Washington is broken. That our governing infrastructure is outdated. That our imperfect democracy and government are in danger of becoming even more flawed – and that to _adequately_ remedy the situation we need to do a lot more than simply change who we elect every two or six years. We need to _substantially reform_ our governing practices and institutions and eliminate the excessive and corrupting influence that money, wealth, and disinformation have over our politics and government.
I want to help fix Washington by advancing _long-overdue_ legislative and constitutional reforms (details @ [www.costelloforsenate.com](http://www.costelloforsenate.com/)) that will not only aid in strengthening our democracy and government, but also help in better protecting our rights and freedoms and assist in more effectively addressing our nation’s most pressing problems.
I also want to help by pushing back against the false narrative that both political parties are responsible for the hyper-partisanship and gridlock in Washington and that only through bipartisan action will genuine progress be achieved. For too long too many politicians, including Maine’s two U.S. senators, have fed into, and benefited politically from this misleading narrative, with little or no public benefit to show for it.
While we Democrats bear some responsibility for Washington’s failures, it’s nothing in comparison to that of the Republican Party (GOP). For over thirty years, the GOP has purposefully chosen to impose government shutdowns, gerrymanders, debt default threats, Senate holds and filibusters, and other means to prevent the enactment of sound, mainstream government policies and reforms. Whereas we Democrats have generally shown a willingness to compromise as we’ve worked hard to enact sound, broadly popular policies, and reforms, only to be thwarted by increasingly hard-lined anti-government Republicans.
With respect to Senator King, I appreciate his years of service, however, he has yet to support the kind of bold, substantive reforms that I believe are needed to truly fix Washington and he’s unlikely to do so during what is likely to be his last term in the U.S. Senate.
So please consider joining me (@ [www.costelloforsenate.com](http://www.costelloforsenate.com/)) in contesting right wing, “no-labels,” and other groundless efforts to label us Democrats as out-of-the-mainstream, intransigent, or worse – and fighting for reforms that I believe are needed to genuinely strengthen our democracy and government and ensure that all Americans are provided with the security, education, job skills, and other life enriching opportunities to thrive.
Sincerely yours,
David Costello
P.S. If you follow social media please consider signing onto/following our Instagram and X (formally Twitter) accounts. Also, feel free to share this email with others.
Instagram: [https://www.instagram.com/costelloforsenate/](https://www.instagram.com/costelloforsenate/)__
Twitter: [https://www.twitter.com/costello4senate/ ](https://www.twitter.com/costello4senate/)

clean_body: 🗳️ | | | | Peter — First, I want to thank all of you for the well wishes over the weekend for my birthday. I was so encouraged by your words and grateful to have your support. Today, I want to talk about anotherholiday that's important to this campaign: National Voter Registration Day. Today is a great reminder to check your voter registration — even if you're fairly certain your information is up to date, lots of things impact your status (voter roll purges, name changes, moving addresses, etc.). Each year, it seems like the stakes of our elections just get higher. From stolen election claims to removing elected leaders, it's no surprise people are starting to lose faith in democracy. Government is meant to work for us. Yet too often politicians grandstand rather than get anything done. As someone who spent their life working across lines of difference to get things done, I'm tired of it, too. That's why I worked to make people's voices heard by increasing enfranchisement through voter registration drives, distributing election materials, and utilizing schools as vote centers. We need problem-solvers in Congress who protect our democracy and ✨ actually ✨ deliver on the issues that matter to us. Here's my commitment to you. In Congress, I will fight for: Expanded voting rights. Protections against gerrymandering. Improved voting laws like early registration, vote by mail, and early voting. Removal of the influence of big money from politics. Thanks again for celebrating with us — both my birthday and National Voter Registration Day! name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zplkqpg9k54t45ackiet165841nupgvnmk6fv2t0_rp22sh2s8i66p75chim8o74c5h2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpu4vgo4v1fjnhlqerjonaksia4emkbjg02jj3qo_rp22sh2s8i66p75chim8o74c5h2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc29t866jdsgr2bn0g0hevbj7r2unh908megu8f8_rp22sh2s8i66p75chim8o74c5h2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhviiaspkh9bsovevnnoapqgd6bne9bg0v0kvbgo_rp22sh2s8i66p75chim8o74c5h2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

| |

| | | I'm at my wits' end, Friend.

Biden and the Democrats just have too much power, too many connections, and too much in their fundraising war chest. Now their sights are set on me.

At this point, if I don't do a total 180 on the fundraising front, not only will I lose my House seat, Republicans may never hold the majority in Congress again.
**Friend, this is Ryan Zinke. I served as President Trump 's Secretary of the Interior and I was the commander at SEAL Team 6.**
**I 'm also running for Congress in the most critical race in the nation.**
But if Biden can destroy me in this race, I can guarantee you no other Republican will have a chance.

subject: A Pro-Israel Democrat running for Congress in AZ-01.

body:
# [#]Team,

I’m writing today to ask you to support Andrei Cherny, a pro-Israel Democrat running for Congress in Arizona’s First Congressional District in one the most winnable races for Democrats in 2024.

I’ve known Andrei for 25 years, and can say without a doubt, that he would be an incredibly strong addition to the group of us trying to bring bipartisan progress to America. He’s been a successful CEO, an Arizona prosecutor, and served as a Navy reserve officer.

For Andrei, the bond between America and Israel is a personal one: All four of his grandparents were concentration camp survivors – imprisoned in places such as Auschwitz in part because there was no state of Israel.

After the war, they were persecuted by the Czech communist government. They were not able to practice their religion freely. His father was the first bar mitzvah after the war, using a tallis that had been smuggled into the country. Andrie’s mother’s father was the leader of the Jewish community in their region and was sent to jail for the crime of “capitalism,” a code word for being Jewish.

But, by that point, there was a difference in the world: the birth of Israel. Both his parents and their families were freed from Czechoslovakia because of Israeli pressure. His mother’s family was able to live out their dream as Zionists and make aliyah to Israel. There, as a teenager, his mother lived on a kibbutz near Hadera.

Andrei has a very strong chance to win this race. He was one of only three Democratic challengers to outraise an incumbent in the last quarter and set a record for the most money raised by an Arizona Congressional candidate in the year before the election. His district is one that was won by President Biden in 2020 and carried by 7% by Mark Kelly last November. But he needs our help to end this quarter strong, and I hope you’ll be able to make a generous contribution to his campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-cherny-split-2309?amount=]

I’ve seen firsthand that we need more strong Pro-Israel Democrats in Congress. Andrei is committed to working with me and others to oppose additional conditions on American aid, fight the BDS movement, ensure we are preventing the rise of a nuclear Iran, and advocate for building on the Abraham Accords.

Thank you,

Josh
Josh Gottheimer represents New Jersey’s Fifth Congressional District. Josh is in Congress to fight for lower taxes and Jersey Values. He’s working across the aisle to find real solutions for New Jersey families and is actively fighting against the ideological gridlock in Washington. subject: Have you seen what's happening in Georgia?
body:
I've never seen anything like this.

| |
---
| | Fellow American, I've never seen anything like this. Fulton County, Georgia's District Attorney isn't just going after President Trump - she's going after his lawyers too. And I don't believe for a second that they've committed any crimes. They did their job as attorneys--provided legal advice based on constitutional interpretation--and now they could go to prison. **Make no mistake - this is bigger than President Trump and it's bigger than Georgia.** The radical Left wants to send a loud, clear message to attorneys across the country that if they question the integrity of elections or provide legal services to conservative candidates, they could be held criminally responsible. **[That's why the Center for American Liberty created the Advocate Defense Fund to help support the legal defense for Trump's lawyers.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=222757d3ec6147579fc205aead6afa43&_e=Xo7BYNoXbXrhHfpTlPec39Dt_qxsyqXqdk3_0MOWk1f8Gzljdjsc_DBTZ9J03PRhjjawE2lRtOz9f6-3BOgaE4ZHpO1QYXtBHVX4n927gSemRfZhTFH-sVUggF6nA0TXNKKige3qafZw7ePtfEY3DRfxA5h-lqxjvtRAUnAZI2cxJId7wCNzGLR097oRq_U5d0vv8156dBGaOYjMIdpRCIvxxLIhWYKyENsKOhBIcXLE79tMaP1T-6f_JMK_ExckNMx7d8EjiGV8AxRAGylxJGpCBzyoeWZ42EWNxVQgrJXQE5IIM4uh8A21eBu0m-SR0r5EZKVMJCac69H2eVYNhKqPDYOZDXvTMXr-1KDFdNhCJTM3CL6a2dFT2WTj-y0_)** Candidates for public office in the U.S. rely on various types of legal counsel to qualify for the ballot, comply with campaign finance requirements, advocate before legislative and administrative bodies, file lawsuits challenging inaccuracies in election administration, and more. Leading presidential candidates NEED legal counsel throughout the country to be competitive. The right of a candidate, and his or her attorneys, to provide legal advice and advocacy is essential to the fundamental, First Amendment-protected act of running for public office. I knew it was risky, but inaction wasn’t possible if I wanted to stay alive. I also knew that this new procedure could become an anchor of debt for the rest of my life. **After the operation, I let my healthcare bill sit on the counter for days out of fear of what was inside. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

subject: Life in prison for doing his job?
body:
I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

name: COURIER
subject: "Both sides" journalism is failing us
body:
Real unbiased and neutral reporting doesn't lend a hand to misinformation.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1592%2E120351%2E7CzHCr)
Telling “both sides” of a story. Maintaining “neutrality” and “balance” in news reporting. In theory, it all sounds great, but if that’s the case, how are conspiracy theories and the right-wing bad actors propagating them more powerful than ever?
Before we get into it, [**can you help power our innovative journalism by pitching in today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230919?refcode=em20230919&amount=5&refcode2=1592_120351_7CzHCr&akid=1592%2E120351%2E7CzHCr)
**Good journalism provides facts, context, history, and fact-checking. Above all else, good journalism _tells the truth, no matter what._**
Yet many mainstream media outlets like CNN fail to meet these standards, clinging to outdated ideals like “telling both sides” of a story or maintaining “balance” in reporting.
We’ve seen that model fail for too long. By putting so-called “balance” first, _everyone_ gets a platform, even con artists like Donald Trump and conspiracy theorists who push everything from QANON lies about election interference to climate denialism.
**As a result, it’s no wonder 185 million Americans don’t trust the news.**
At COURIER, we always put the truth first. Our mission is to bring transformational change to American journalism. We don’t platform right-wing extremists and their dangerous BS, and we serve communities who don’t have access to quality, local journalism.
**And, we do all this _without_ a paywall or subscription fees because we believe good information should be accessible to everyone in the online spaces where people actually get their news.**
Our network of nine newsrooms offers credible and trustworthy journalism as an alternative to the mainstream media’s overly sensationalized headlines and profit-driven motives, but to keep the lights on in our newsrooms, we rely on grassroots supporters like you. [**Can you chip in anything you can today to keep COURIER's reporting at the forefront of combating disinformation?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230919?refcode=em20230919&amount=5&refcode2=1592_120351_7CzHCr&akid=1592%2E120351%2E7CzHCr)

subject: It's not illegal to practice law
body:
I've never seen anything like this.

| |
---
| | Fellow American, I've never seen anything like this. Fulton County, Georgia's District Attorney isn't just going after President Trump - she's going after his lawyers too. And I don't believe for a second that they've committed any crimes. They did their job as attorneys--provided legal advice based on constitutional interpretation--and now they could go to prison. **Make no mistake - this is bigger than President Trump and it's bigger than Georgia.** The radical Left wants to send a loud, clear message to attorneys across the country that if they question the integrity of elections or provide legal services to conservative candidates, they could be held criminally responsible. **[That's why the Center for American Liberty created the Advocate Defense Fund to help support the legal defense for Trump's lawyers.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3ca734f1f1e450a817a6644786d933b&_e=xR859RA0tX0kEFRlIQHOePc0FhnIt-Fcl_eK1RkCWFnwOXOFkI6ypaKm44eDJg9yimfojB8Yz4qtEOLP_8cvJOA1j4I2UotghFEdK5gWOqV81eZA2gZA1ExX0D63uPApV7sjkouiTefeJM_Dbe2xgSvzVGiU7yCLn1BV5GPqRF2qa4o6FXals_9WMcLbYx3XH_M2_rbuM8iAIpXi3j-DkyQqu9dxD1uXZe-3Yq8iJcKUCmRf7qRfMYaWt095OQDHa9_fFXNtzH1S_LJv69Aj7BNX7F3DM3T7ZsdHNgc2XQCAndKuUmDU4JeQtFGTrBhi4QdLAWMq4tl1IVGZrc8LI80zAhuVEv3YJ9ZqE_HzK4g%3D)** Candidates for public office in the U.S. rely on various types of legal counsel to qualify for the ballot, comply with campaign finance requirements, advocate before legislative and administrative bodies, file lawsuits challenging inaccuracies in election administration, and more. Leading presidential candidates NEED legal counsel throughout the country to be competitive. The right of a candidate, and his or her attorneys, to provide legal advice and advocacy is essential to the fundamental, First Amendment-protected act of running for public office. Any attack on these rights threatens not only the speech and petition rights of campaigns, but also the rights of the tens of millions of Americans who vote in our elections. **[That's why we're launching our Advocate Defense Fund and why I hope I can count on your emergency donation of $35 or more today.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3ca734f1f1e450a817a6644786d933b&_e=xR859RA0tX0kEFRlIQHOePc0FhnIt-Fcl_eK1RkCWFnwOXOFkI6ypaKm44eDJg9yimfojB8Yz4qtEOLP_8cvJOA1j4I2UotghFEdK5gWOqV81eZA2gZA1ExX0D63uPApV7sjkouiTefeJM_Dbe2xgSvzVGiU7yCLn1BV5GPqRF2qa4o6FXals_9WMcLbYx3XH_M2_rbuM8iAIpXi3j-Dk6VJEwD4l9YJuIqlQNmoeT9W8rVRH1VohY2G67ZMG39Fi01XBzOCu0TjGSwA98VxH6lfWXvyRq7GnQ8N_gheJe1uNpw08COP-NuHkgfpAzFUBwyVd4ESMFOYKhe0k185Bf0hHmF94ncHRF6I9IwNbc0%3D)** With your support we're going to help defend the attorneys who are being politically persecuted in Fulton County, Georgia. It's up to us to send a loud and clear message of our own - we won't stand idly by while corrupt prosecutors distort the law. The lawyers targeted by the Fulton County, GA District Attorney may have to spend millions of dollars in legal fees to defend their innocence and preserve their liberty. **[That's why I'm asking you to become a founding member of the Advocate Defense Fund today and give a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3ca734f1f1e450a817a6644786d933b&_e=xR859RA0tX0kEFRlIQHOePc0FhnIt-Fcl_eK1RkCWFnwOXOFkI6ypaKm44eDJg9yimfojB8Yz4qtEOLP_8cvJOA1j4I2UotghFEdK5gWOqV81eZA2gZA1ExX0D63uPApV7sjkouiTefeJM_Dbe2xgSvzVGiU7yCLn1BV5GPqRF2qa4o6FXals_9WMcLbYx3XH_M2_rbuM8iAIpXi3j-DkxIHFuAZ2h3GPlNPsB3W666WJJH48t-h7lgEoTqQpquWThLFj2xmjtv0jMVtWNY4GvcOwGx4WzIaWgQBMSv496cL8OPMheSiY6WnRIDQFV4i28KDhyR01qsG3fd2GDfhHhDGNqILxlMhV8YOxqNjnmw%3D)** 100% of the funds donated to our Advocate Defense Fund go directly to the representation of lawyers politically indicted in Fulton County, Georgia. This threatens everything we stand for, and we're fighting it with everything we have. But we don't stand a chance without you. Thank you in advance for your support.

body:

| | Fellow American, I've never seen anything like this. Fulton County, Georgia's District Attorney isn't just going after President Trump - she's going after his lawyers too. And I don't believe for a second that they've committed any crimes. They did their job as attorneys--provided legal advice based on constitutional interpretation--and now they could go to prison. **Make no mistake - this is bigger than President Trump and it's bigger than Georgia.** The radical Left wants to send a loud, clear message to attorneys across the country that if they question the integrity of elections or provide legal services to conservative candidates, they could be held criminally responsible. **[That's why the Center for American Liberty created the Advocate Defense Fund to help support the legal defense for Trump's lawyers.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4de75948f9384e1fb0c388bb60360bb8&_e=wxuu-3bs4ypljDDmJthSEFgLTP5EfAJBKzLWBn-R9ScqfVC69tI_81_xR-HIbEjmEU2uCP5On-7y9DMQ19rZDG1F6hcRK5zVDEDshtvUbmUUYVtzeZKjx98LnltRyGaGXOjclKONHSyzmup26WNu9yuNX3_mOuIokOEX16kNcBBIEZABGEiskZeRL7I3PHu6fzl6Ts8grg9qI0aR9yIYVZ9EzN8YGWt_aOVjlL2ZebR0jdReTP7-YFVhh4q1L7Vrg382xm5D7OAx1Sf7uVVOmruZWUu4wi-xQXcuMFZiSzY_TtXTiIa4grg_OOC9wYXptz2nGhYFhc5qwvcL-HroCOdWGBxhWleHRTFP7mA8TVjodVtSUueLOnUP_WK7nwfc)** Candidates for public office in the U.S. rely on various types of legal counsel to qualify for the ballot, comply with campaign finance requirements, advocate before legislative and administrative bodies, file lawsuits challenging inaccuracies in election administration, and more. Leading presidential candidates NEED legal counsel throughout the country to be competitive. The right of a candidate, and his or her attorneys, to provide legal advice and advocacy is essential to the fundamental, First Amendment-protected act of running for public office. Any attack on these rights threatens not only the speech and petition rights of campaigns, but also the rights of the tens of millions of Americans who vote in our elections. **[That's why we're launching our Advocate Defense Fund and why I hope I can count on your emergency donation of $35 or more today.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4de75948f9384e1fb0c388bb60360bb8&_e=wxuu-3bs4ypljDDmJthSEFgLTP5EfAJBKzLWBn-R9ScqfVC69tI_81_xR-HIbEjmEU2uCP5On-7y9DMQ19rZDG1F6hcRK5zVDEDshtvUbmUUYVtzeZKjx98LnltRyGaGXOjclKONHSyzmup26WNu9yuNX3_mOuIokOEX16kNcBBIEZABGEiskZeRL7I3PHu6fzl6Ts8grg9qI0aR9yIYVXqQMkhDzpkaLg2KdgtCSN9Ld-mScV_KhEi7dw4g2Cc6Lrw-3_mbAbfxYmneNI82GHE6wofyekXgwe4DhSxiUvx_ofnyQ0SK1QA_21DCJrGqM9wPV6E-Z2Cri-C6ZoQgLjXgps8eP0m1W_7rbWdd2n6JtGLHOmB6El9PapbQOH71)** With your support we're going to help defend the attorneys who are being politically persecuted in Fulton County, Georgia. It's up to us to send a loud and clear message of our own - we won't stand idly by while corrupt prosecutors distort the law. The lawyers targeted by the Fulton County, GA District Attorney may have to spend millions of dollars in legal fees to defend their innocence and preserve their liberty. **[That's why I'm asking you to become a founding member of the Advocate Defense Fund today and give a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4de75948f9384e1fb0c388bb60360bb8&_e=wxuu-3bs4ypljDDmJthSEFgLTP5EfAJBKzLWBn-R9ScqfVC69tI_81_xR-HIbEjmEU2uCP5On-7y9DMQ19rZDG1F6hcRK5zVDEDshtvUbmUUYVtzeZKjx98LnltRyGaGXOjclKONHSyzmup26WNu9yuNX3_mOuIokOEX16kNcBBIEZABGEiskZeRL7I3PHu6fzl6Ts8grg9qI0aR9yIYVXqexfap_Lo1z7I-gy8LJeULx4qqJarckGBJVbk37n659O9O-Rd5En0kgSoO1_jn-UNNODPKNeBlZD-1eVXete1c3VltXSPxhs0iQ-pMcFq7O36Zq7SDEYfB05lAFdJjTjozvLsQzRFV_ryeQZqhStuE-_BlpPeZk-YhHC3Xk8XP)** 100% of the funds donated to our Advocate Defense Fund go directly to the representation of lawyers politically indicted in Fulton County, Georgia. clean_body: I've never seen anything like this. | | | | Fellow American, I've never seen anything like this. Fulton County, Georgia's District Attorney isn't just going after President Trump - she's going after his lawyers too. And I don't believe for a second that they've committed any crimes. They did their job as attorneys--provided legal advice based on constitutional interpretation--and now they could go to prison. Make no mistake - this is bigger than President Trump and it's bigger than Georgia. The radical Left wants to send a loud, clear message to attorneys across the country that if they question the integrity of elections or provide legal services to conservative candidates, they could be held criminally responsible. Candidates for public office in the U.S. rely on various types of legal counsel to qualify for the ballot, comply with campaign finance requirements, advocate before legislative and administrative bodies, file lawsuits challenging inaccuracies in election administration, and more. Leading presidential candidates NEED legal counsel throughout the country to be competitive. The right of a candidate, and his or her attorneys, to provide legal advice and advocacy is essential to the fundamental, First Amendment-protected act of running for public office. Any attack on these rights threatens not only the speech and petition rights of campaigns, but also the rights of the tens of millions of Americans who vote in our elections. With your support we're going to help defend the attorneys who are being politically persecuted in Fulton County, Georgia. It's up to us to send a loud and clear message of our own - we won't stand idly by while corrupt prosecutors distort the law. The lawyers targeted by the Fulton County, GA District Attorney may have to spend millions of dollars in legal fees to defend their innocence and preserve their liberty. 100% of the funds donated to our Advocate Defense Fund go directly to the representation of lawyers politically indicted in Fulton County, Georgia. This threatens everything we stand for, and we're fighting it with everything we have. But we don't stand a chance without you. Thank you in advance for your support. | | Sincerely, Harmeet K. body:
My story of meeting Jeffrey Epstein is unusual.

[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=68d27ef79b8c42b7b8f5f6e9a920cc25&_e=MRuUEpo_Y4LouzFwCyJR09SSIddMXyI2FXwdAzpodV1dybTve_UFOLCelX_bgxH2hg0qO4Zak7vbkJiYNFfXFFeXT4N97Y6sbCziSBYzx_2pyWAWAhJhptECsWAUMSPEa0AJEI4oTDkaJucUiO1DNMzqReh22lm7Al6aRC98A3ZZCtzJMXDt8ltyVwAzhPQJlTnvt9xFmJPSMJYN_dmwFgA3H-HkZ6YmI0If0BJWSVLH0jkyDG-tw7rf7VatHNAIWvu7eCgT18r6BTzQuEuJAaH2_d7Z1MdrrbZJaQwwkyU%3D)
Friend,

My story of meeting Jeffrey Epstein is unusual. Fortunately for me, I didn't end up one of his victims. At the time, I was 27 years old and, by then, too old and well-connected (and protected) for his tastes.

We met in Aspen, Colorado. He was charming, funny, and attentive. He offered me a ride back to NYC on his private jet. With several friends in common, I had no reason to suspect the darkness that hid behind his glamorous facade.

Shortly thereafter, he invited me down to his palatial estate in Palm Beach, but once I arrived, I knew something was wrong. He was naked in his pool, making calls. When I declined to similarly disrobe, he started making vulgar remarks about my bathing suit and make-up.

**Before I tell you the rest of my story, allow me to introduce myself _(Please keep reading)_.**

My name is Jennifer Grossman (JAG), and I serve as the CEO of The Atlas Society. Our mission is to engage young people with the ideas of Ayn Rand in creative ways to equip the next generation with the virtues of reason, productivity, and achievement.

In a world in which young women, in particular, are vulnerable to the irrational, destructive woke agenda of the left--peddling victimhood, envy, resentment, fear, and entitlement--Ayn Rand's inspiring female protagonists and her empowering message of individualism and freedom, can help young women defend themselves against predators, whether dangerous deviants like Jeffrey Epstein, or predatory leftists seeking to prey on gullibility to amass power.

**[You can support The Atlas Society's mission by donating $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or ANY amount by clicking here >>>](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=68d27ef79b8c42b7b8f5f6e9a920cc25&_e=MRuUEpo_Y4LouzFwCyJR09SSIddMXyI2FXwdAzpodV1dybTve_UFOLCelX_bgxH2hg0qO4Zak7vbkJiYNFfXFFeXT4N97Y6sbCziSBYzx_2pyWAWAhJhptECsWAUMSPEa0AJEI4oTDkaJucUiO1DNPrxbCoO40eIA4rL691iNMTe-x1ZYEwy11fQ_IxFVgNOyplp5xLzf2UPFuskTFkzpoY85SiAI61_uo-x-_TNexiosZpcr3ieXdI0RoXjG5svkrrvAMr3hmyIiZsKL7ui0amuDKBstO9zQWv3A6HIAhc%3D)**

**The rest of my story with Jeffrey Epstein: ⬇️⬇️⬇️**

Fortunately, I believe Epstein recognized I was not a suitable candidate to become one of his victims. At 27 years old, I was already 13 years older than his oldest victim.

Predators like Epstein are also experts at recognizing the weak and vulnerable--and avoiding those with experience and resources.

**Why am I telling you this story, and how does it relate to our mission at The Atlas Society?**

Here's the ugly truth: The story of Jeffrey Epstein is about more than perversion and predation. **It 's about power** -- gaining power over his victims and wielding power over the rich and powerful he hoped to ensnare in his network.

His strategy was all about finding shortcuts, cutting corners, and manipulating others. He didn't seek productive win-win relationships with equals but rather sought to bring others (girls and peers) down to his own depraved level. He didn't seek to live with integrity -- he sought to destroy it in others.

It's the absolute antithesis of the vision presented in Ayn Rand's novels like _Atlas Shrugged_ and _The Fountainhead_ , where heroic entrepreneurs and independent creative geniuses pursue lives of productivity and integrity.

Even critics of Ayn Rand's fiction acknowledge that her villains are eerily accurate characterizations of the moochers, looters, and second-handers we see around us -- people trying to get something for nothing, not by bringing their best efforts and ideas to the table, but by promoting fear and victimhood to exploit others.

**At The Atlas Society, we 're helping young people recognize -- and defend themselves -- against such parasites.**

In a day and age where daily book reading has plummeted 85% since the late 1970s, we introduce young people to Rand's philosophy of individualism, honesty, and responsibility through wildly creative means such as graphic novels, animated videos, edgy social media, as well as weekly events and our annual student conference.

body:
It is a tremendous honor and responsibility to serve in Congress, but I must admit there’s one part of the job I’m not that fond of: Fundraising. **** It is a tremendous honor and responsibility to serve in Congress, but I must admit there’s one part of the job I’m not that fond of: Fundraising.

State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates

State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

| | FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Sun Reader,
---
| | In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don’t wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

More can always be done to return more money to Virginians’ pockets, support veterans, empower parents and students, and strengthen our public safety. | | FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Sun Reader,
---
| | In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don’t wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

In case you’d like to learn more about it, let’s relive that fateful day:** ** In September 2010, I was serving as part of the Joint Special Operations Command in Afghanistan. We had just acquired the location of a high-value target and were moving in under the cover of darkness. ** ** Suddenly, there was a loud bang and a bright flash. I was thrown up into the air. I landed with a thud—the wind knocked out of me. I couldn’t see much with the soot and dirt covering my eyes, but as I went to wipe the mud away, I immediately knew my fingers were bent in ways they were not meant to bend. ** ** I remember every moment of the explosion, down to my teeth rattling so hard I wasn’t sure that they were still in my mouth. The next thing I knew, I was in Walter Reed National Military Medical Center. I looked down to the end of my bed where my feet should have been sticking up, but they weren’t. ** ** As I reflect back on September 19, 2010, it’s clear to me that the fight for freedom won’t be won unless we all work together. ** ** Just like **I’d be dead if my fellow soldiers hadn’t run toward that explosion** , our country stands no chance of surviving if we don’t work together now to defend liberty and freedom here at home. **

| | Dear Friends and Neighbors,

Last Saturday, I had the honor of being one of 140 volunteers who worked at the 7th Annual Fall Bash at the Community Fire Company of New Tripoli. More than 2,200 people showed up to raise money and support the firefighters. That’s almost three times the number of people who actually live in New Tripoli.

First responders and their families work tirelessly to serve their communities. They put themselves in harm’s way, participate in rigorous training, and do it all for no pay. They make great sacrifices for the rest of us, as the New Tripoli Fire Company knows too well.

We have a lot of problems in our country. Inflation. Crime. Lawless borders. Budget deficits. Drugs. Violence. Immorality. The list goes on and on. These are difficult challenges even with the right people in public office, and some of these problems can’t be fixed by an act of Congress.

But when I attend a smalltown celebration like I did on Saturday, I know we still have hope. And these types of uniquely American scenes of service are still happening regularly across the greater Lehigh Valley.

In just the past two weeks, I’ve visited a church in Bethlehem and a mosque in Allentown serving food for the community. I’ve seen volunteers providing safe spaces for homeless women to have their babies. And I’ve watched community leaders come together to support extracurricular activities in local schools. People around here still know what it means to “Love Thy Neighbor.”

In a recent news article, New Tripoli Fire Company Deputy Chief Nick Gruber explained, “We all work full-time jobs, families, sports. You name it. We’re doing it like everyone else.”

Yes, you are, Nick. And thank God you and others like you still find time to serve.

Have faith. Our country is going to be okay because 140 ordinary people still show up in New Tripoli on a Saturday afternoon to help their neighbors.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a husband and father who has lived in the Lehigh Valley for 40 years. He's the founder of a successful technology company and a 28-year veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces. Kevin's not running for Congress because he needs a job. He's running because he's got the experience, vision, and courage to defend our American way of life. _

In January, police shot and killed an activist named Tortuguita in a hail of 57 bullets, while Tortuguita sat in the forest with their arms raised. Police lied and tried to blame Tortuguita for shooting first, but autopsies exonerated the activist.
None of the officers involved in this unconscionable murder and cover-up have been charged.
But activists who passed out flyers about it were charged with an outrageous felony, and have been held in solitary confinement without bail.
After charging 42 activists with domestic terrorism for acting within their rights, Georgia’s Attorney General charged 61 activists last week with state RICO charges in order to further criminalize dissent.
This extreme government overreach is an unconstitutional attempt to silence dissent, and it’s time to hold those responsible accountable. If we don’t act, it will set a frightening precedent.

**Happy Voter Registration Day!**

To me, voting is a DUTY. Sure, it sounds like work, but across this country, many states are making it easier to vote and some are working to make it much, much harder. And that is why it is so important to make sure you are ready to go when Election Day comes. TODAY IS VOTER REGISTRATION DAY! So let’s make sure you are registered to vote. (Note: for some of these steps you may need to have a NY.gov account. Don’t be afraid, it’s easy, painless, and you might find you can access a lot of good stuff this way like the DMV who will let you know your registration is expiring before you get a ticket.)

**STEP 1:** You [**can click**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70011802/428009101/1225426543?refcode=EM_NBI_LWG_20230919_FR_VoterReg_0_CST_Liz_na_na_na&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU0OTkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODg0OWQzYTgtMjk1Ny1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=fstfMXdKw_5icktHtXi43r6yvgvEB8Cf2oZeKQLpjKY=&emci=4073fe72-1e57-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=8849d3a8-2957-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=14515669) here to check your status. You ARE registered? FANTASTIC! You can go to step 3!

**STEP 2:** You aren’t registered? You can register online right now. [**Click here to register**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70011803/428009102/-537280949?refcode=EM_NBI_LWG_20230919_FR_VoterReg_0_CST_Liz_na_na_na&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU0OTkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODg0OWQzYTgtMjk1Ny1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=fstfMXdKw_5icktHtXi43r6yvgvEB8Cf2oZeKQLpjKY=&emci=4073fe72-1e57-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=8849d3a8-2957-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=14515669).

**STEP 3:** Choose a party. (See below for why)

**STEP 4:** Vote in EVERY election! Locals, school board, homecoming court, whatever! Just make sure to vote, because everyone is entitled to your opinion.

**Are you REGISTERED already? Don’t be late to this party!**

New York has closed primaries – this means if you aren’t registered as a member of a party by the end of the day on **FEBRUARY 14** , you will not be able to vote in primaries occurring in that calendar year. In some districts in New York, voting in a primary is the ONLY way to have the opportunity to weigh in on who you want representing you.

**To help you remember:** Just think: I ❤️ voting! (Valentine’s Day does sneak up on us pretty fast and you may be a procrastinator who has to assemble a passable bouquet from the left behind flowers at the bodega and that can be kind of time-consuming, so maybe you should [**just click here right now**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70011804/428009103/-537280949?refcode=EM_NBI_LWG_20230919_FR_VoterReg_0_CST_Liz_na_na_na&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU0OTkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODg0OWQzYTgtMjk1Ny1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=fstfMXdKw_5icktHtXi43r6yvgvEB8Cf2oZeKQLpjKY=&emci=4073fe72-1e57-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=8849d3a8-2957-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=14515669) and get it done.)

subject: Sign The Petition: Florida manatees are starving to death
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1995683?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | Imagine you are a manatee floating peacefully along in Florida’s Gulf Coast waters. You’re a gentle giant -- your species is known for your calm and friendly demeanor, and you mostly spend your days drifting with the current and grazing the seagrass. But today, you’re feeling especially lazy and weak because you’re **malnourished.** It’s been a while since you’ve had a full meal. **If you don’t find more seagrass to feed on soon, you will likely __DIE OF STARVATION__ like several of your kind have done recently...** Sadly, this is the reality for far too many manatees over the past few years. These beloved animals are rapidly dying out in large part due to the devastating _**loss of seagrass,**_ a vital food source for manatees. In fact, manatees are reaching unprecedented record-breaking death tolls -- with nearly _**2,000 manatees DEAD**_ over the past two years alone. Last year, _**261**_ of these gentle giants were wiped out in a _single period of just a few weeks._ _**But where has all the seagrass gone, Friend?**_ You guessed it -- _corporate greed._ The cruise industry is one of the corporate giants wreaking havoc on sensitive manatee habitats in the Florida waters, recklessly (and sometimes illegally) dumping massive amounts of **TOXIC WASTE** and **HARMFUL POLLUTANTS** into the ocean, causing irreparable damage to seagrass beds. _**Without seagrass, manatees cannot survive.**_ These harmless creatures are counting on us to be their voice, so we’re calling on **1,874** activists like you to help us stand up to Big Cruise. [**Please, Friend, don’t let manatees disappear forever. Add your name right now to speak up for these gentle giants before our 11:59 P.M. petition deadline >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1995684?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1995685?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Not only is seagrass essential to manatee survival, it’s also important vegetation for our ecosystems. Seagrass helps promote healthy coastal communities and the planet by storing _**almost 1⁄5 of the world’s ocean carbon. **_
Yet, despite the environmental significance of this critical marine plant, profit-driven cruise companies continue to increase ship traffic, size, and volume while carelessly churning up **toxic wastewater, sand, and other contaminants** into Florida’s waters -- _**compromising water quality and damaging marine habitats.**_
Friend, there’s still a chance to restore seagrass beds and save the manatee population if we can generate enough public pressure on the Environmental Protection Agency to STOP Big Cruise’s dangerous ocean pollution. [**Your voice is critical in this fight. Will you sign our urgent petition right now to defend our oceans and our manatees from corporate greed? SIGN NOW >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1995686?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

name: Justin Kwasa, LCV
subject: Join us to celebrate National Voter Registration Day!
body:
Help us reach 5,000 comments to overcome corporate polluters.? Tell the EPA:
PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS
The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur.

Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again.

GOAL: 5,000 actions
TAKE ACTION https://links.messages.lcv. ? ?
? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents.

This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health.

Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces.

Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/EZ_Rc9~VGdtY/VSt1V0czYTdxRVI4U2RIaHpycWVLUmRkK0p1SnUxMWNBSFZ1ZjlwVjByMXF6d0htbzV0OGhxSEVzbjRXSUJzU1hyaXB2SVRVWmdvSEZOSXZ4ZkpUS0Z0aXNqNXFwTmFmTGQva3N3bW9LOTg9S0/UjdCV0hwQ1o2T3YzR1hvZklPUzZEbW1EWFQwVlNFd1BJMXFadEVCeDdiYWQxbFk2TUJ1bzJYb0h5YnUzMnltUHNGZFduWU8ycDlHMEkwUTRLSzQvOTRDQVdOQW1JSDNFZXJFM1FHL2VNUzg9S0

We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks.

But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers.

Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters.

Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. https://links.messages.lcv.

Thank you for taking action to protect people and workers from environmental disasters.

Sincerely,

Madeleine Foote
Deputy Legislative Director

### **Maricopa County, District 2 Deserves Better**

_ Michelle Ugenti-Rita, former State Senator, releases the following statement:_

September 19, 2023 \- Today, I am announcing my candidacy for the office of County Supervisor, District 2, Maricopa County Board of Supervisors. The voters of District 2 have been deeply disappointed by the actions of appointed Supervisor Thomas Galvin. Whether it is defending botched elections, fiscal mismanagement (including support for the Prop 400 transportation tax increase) or abdicating his responsibility to the residents in Rio Verde Foothills when they desperately needed a solution for their water problem. For too long, the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors has lacked transparency, flown under the radar without accountability and been beholden to entrenched bureaucrats and special interests. It is time to call them what they really are, RINOs, and expose the county cartel that has been facilitating and perpetuating a liberal woke agenda. The district deserves better. “District 2 is a Republican district and the voters want and deserve a Supervisor who reflects those conservative principles. They are tired of being sold out time and time again when politicians like Galvin who claim to be conservative in order to win their vote, then turn around and support, bloated budgets, tax increases and woke gender politics that only succeed in growing government. This stands in stark contrast to my unmatched 12 year record of successfully delivering conservative results to the voters.” I am honored to have the continued support and endorsement of Congressman David Schweikert (R-D1) who said “Michelle has a stellar and proven record of principled, conservative leadership. I'm confident that she will make an excellent county supervisor. I'm proud to give her my full endorsement and I encourage my fellow Republicans to join me in voting for her in next year's Republican primary.” In addition to Congressman Schweikert, Michelle is endorsed by Senator John Kavanagh (LD-3), Representative Joseph Chaplik (LD-3), Representative Barbara Parker (LD-10), Jacqueline Parker (LD-15) Senator Wendy Rogers (LD-7) and the Honorable Kelly Townsend (Former Representative LD-16).
### ###
